## File: docs/rules/AI Tells (Forbidden Patterns).md
`````markdown
 1: # AI Tells (Forbidden Patterns)
 2: 
 3: This document lists UI patterns that signal generic AI-generated output.
 4: 
 5: These patterns are banned. If you see them, flag and remove immediately.
 6: 
 7: ---
 8: 
 9: # Color Tells
10: 
11: - Purple-to-blue gradient backgrounds as a default.
12: - Near-black with acid-green or vermilion accents.
13: - Warm cream (#F4F1EA) with serif display and terracotta accent.
14: - Default Tailwind color palette used without customization.
15: - Multiple accent colors on a single page.
16: - Random gradient overlays without design justification.
17: 
18: ---
19: 
20: # Layout Tells
21: 
22: - Cards nested inside cards.
23: - Uniform equal spacing everywhere.
24: - Perfectly centered hero with no asymmetric element.
25: - Every section using the same layout family.
26: - Bento grids with mismatched cell counts.
27: - Generic "Welcome to Next.js" boilerplate left in production.
28: - Sections that all look like stacked cards.
29: 
30: ---
31: 
32: # Typography Tells
33: 
34: - Inter used for every project without justification.
35: - Em-dash (U+2014) or en-dash (U+2013) in visible text.
36: - No `text-wrap: balance` on headlines.
37: - No `text-wrap: pretty` on body text.
38: - Body text exceeding 65ch line length.
39: - Inconsistent type scale across sections.
40: 
41: ---
42: 
43: # Interaction Tells
44: 
45: - No animation or transition on any interactive element.
46: - No visible press states on buttons.
47: - Hit areas smaller than 40x40px.
48: - Borders used instead of shadows for visual separation.
49: - Single-layer box-shadow instead of three-layer composition.
50: - No `prefers-reduced-motion` support.
51: 
52: ---
53: 
54: # Component Tells
55: 
56: - Huge monolithic components.
57: - Business logic mixed into UI components.
58: - Database queries inside components.
59: - Inline styles instead of Tailwind.
60: - Disabled ESLint or TypeScript rules.
61: - Unused imports or dead code.
62: 
63: ---
64: 
65: # Content Tells
66: 
67: - Generic placeholder text left in production.
68: - "Lorem ipsum" or "Your content here."
69: - Overly verbose hero sections.
70: - CTAs hidden below the fold.
71: - Navigation with more than 7 items.
72: 
73: ---
74: 
75: # How to Use
76: 
77: Before shipping any UI, scan against this list.
78: 
79: If any tell is found:
80: 
81: 1. Identify the root cause.
82: 2. Apply the fix from `docs/Design Rules.md`.
83: 3. Document the decision if it conflicts with an existing pattern.
84: 
85: ---
86: 
87: # Sources
88: 
89: Adapted from:
90: 
91: - Taste Skill v2 (Leon Lin) - Anti-slop ruleset.
92: - Impeccable (Paul Bakaus) - 45-rule detector, named anti-slop tells.
93: - Anthropic frontend-design - Distributional convergence research.
94: - Vercel web-design-guidelines - Audit layer findings.
`````

## File: docs/rules/Anthropic Frontend Design Rules.md
`````markdown
 1: # Anthropic Frontend Design Rules
 2: 
 3: Standards from Anthropic's frontend-design skill for building distinctive, high-quality web interfaces.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Core Principle
 8: 
 9: The more aesthetic improvements map to implementable frontend code, the better the output.
10: 
11: Design taste is articulable logic, not vibes.
12: 
13: ---
14: 
15: # Aesthetic Direction
16: 
17: Before building, commit to a direction:
18: 
19: - Pick a 4-6 value named hex palette.
20: - Choose one justified aesthetic risk.
21: - Define a hero thesis (one sentence that captures the page intent).
22: - Avoid default palettes: warm cream + serif + terracotta, near-black + acid-green, broadsheet hairline-rule layouts.
23: 
24: ---
25: 
26: # Process
27: 
28: Two-pass build-critique:
29: 
30: 1. Build the interface with committed direction.
31: 2. Critique against the design rules. Revise.
32: 
33: Never ship on the first pass.
34: 
35: ---
36: 
37: # Typography
38: 
39: - Use `text-wrap: balance` on headlines.
40: - Use `text-wrap: pretty` on body text.
41: - Line length: 45-90 characters (max-w-[65ch]).
42: - Enable font smoothing: `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`.
43: - Use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` for numeric data.
44: 
45: ---
46: 
47: # Restraint and Self-Critique
48: 
49: - Every element must earn its place.
50: - If an element does not serve the hero thesis, remove it.
51: - Default to more whitespace than feels necessary.
52: - Add density deliberately, not by default.
53: - Use fewer borders. Prefer shadows, color contrast, and spacing.
54: 
55: ---
56: 
57: # Writing in Design
58: 
59: - Headlines: max 2 lines.
60: - Subtext: max 20 words.
61: - CTA visible without scrolling.
62: - No em-dashes or en-dashes in visible text.
63: - Body text should feel conversational, not corporate.
64: 
65: ---
66: 
67: # Anti-Patterns
68: 
69: - Inter for everything without justification.
70: - Purple-to-blue gradients as default.
71: - Cards nested in cards.
72: - Uniform equal spacing everywhere.
73: - Generic AI-generated layouts.
74: 
75: ---
76: 
77: # Sources
78: 
79: - Anthropic frontend-design skill (Apache-2.0).
80: - Anthropic blog: "Improving frontend design through Skills" (2025-11-12).
81: - anthropics/skills repository.
`````

## File: docs/rules/Dark Mode Protocol.md
`````markdown
 1: # Dark Mode Protocol
 2: 
 3: Rules for implementing and maintaining dark mode across the project.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Implementation
 8: 
 9: - Dark mode uses the `.dark` class on the root element.
10: - Toggle at the layout level, not per component.
11: - Persist user preference in localStorage.
12: - Respect `prefers-color-scheme` as the default.
13: 
14: ---
15: 
16: # Color Tokens
17: 
18: - All colors defined as CSS custom properties in `globals.css`.
19: - Light and dark variants for each token.
20: - Use oklch color space for perceptually uniform colors.
21: - Never hardcode color values in components.
22: 
23: ---
24: 
25: # Background Rules
26: 
27: - Never use pure black (#000) for backgrounds.
28: - Use dark grays (e.g., oklch(0.15 0.01 250)) for surfaces.
29: - Layer surfaces with subtle lightness differences.
30: - Use shadows (white at low opacity) for depth in dark mode.
31: 
32: ---
33: 
34: # Text Rules
35: 
36: - Primary text: near-white, not pure white (#FFF).
37: - Secondary text: medium gray with sufficient contrast.
38: - Ensure WCAG AA contrast ratios in both modes.
39: - Never use color alone to convey meaning.
40: 
41: ---
42: 
43: # Border and Shadow Rules
44: 
45: - Borders: use white at 8-12% opacity in dark mode.
46: - Shadows: compose from three layers (ambient, key, rim).
47: - Prefer shadows over borders for visual separation.
48: - Adjust shadow color for dark mode (use lighter shadows).
49: 
50: ---
51: 
52: # Component Rules
53: 
54: - Every component must work in both themes.
55: - Test all interactive states (hover, focus, active) in both modes.
56: - Use `cn()` utility for conditional theme classes.
57: - Never use `dark:` prefix on every property. Use token-based theming.
58: 
59: ---
60: 
61: # Image Treatment
62: 
63: - Image outlines: 1px at 10% opacity (white in dark mode, black in light mode).
64: - Avoid bright images on dark backgrounds without subtle containment.
65: - Use `next/image` with `dark:` variants when needed.
66: 
67: ---
68: 
69: # Documentation Rules
70: 
71: Every significant change should update the relevant documentation.
72: 
73: Architecture decisions should be documented before implementation whenever possible.
74: 
75: Documentation should always reflect the current state of the project.
`````

## File: docs/rules/Em-Dash Ban.md
`````markdown
 1: # Em-Dash Ban
 2: 
 3: The em-dash (U+2014) and en-dash (U+2013) are banned anywhere in visible text.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Rules
 8: 
 9: - Never use em-dash (U+2014) in visible text.
10: - Never use en-dash (U+2013) in visible text.
11: - Use the hyphen (-) for all dash-like purposes.
12: - Use the math minus sign only in mathematical expressions.
13: 
14: ---
15: 
16: # Why
17: 
18: This rule comes from the Taste Skill framework (Leon Lin).
19: 
20: LLMs default to em-dashes and en-dashes because they appear frequently in training data. Banning them forces more deliberate punctuation and breaks the generic AI writing pattern.
21: 
22: ---
23: 
24: # Examples
25: 
26: Incorrect:
27: 
28: ```
29: The feature supports authentication - including OAuth and magic links.
30: ```
31: 
32: Correct:
33: 
34: ```
35: The feature supports authentication - including OAuth and magic links.
36: ```
37: 
38: Incorrect:
39: 
40: ```
41: Our platform offers three tiers - Basic, Pro, and Enterprise.
42: ```
43: 
44: Correct:
45: 
46: ```
47: Our platform offers three tiers - Basic, Pro, and Enterprise.
48: ```
49: 
50: ---
51: 
52: # Enforcement
53: 
54: - Check all visible text in components.
55: - Check markdown documentation (internal only).
56: - Do not check code comments or string literals that are not rendered.
57: 
58: ---
59: 
60: # Sources
61: 
62: - Taste Skill v2 (Leon Lin) - Em-dash and en-dash ban.
`````

## File: docs/rules/Hero Discipline.md
`````markdown
 1: # Hero Discipline
 2: 
 3: Rules for building effective hero sections.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Constraints
 8: 
 9: - Headline: max 2 lines.
10: - Subtext: max 20 words.
11: - CTA visible without scrolling.
12: - Top padding: max `pt-24`.
13: - Max 4 text elements in the hero.
14: 
15: ---
16: 
17: # Structure
18: 
19: A hero section contains:
20: 
21: 1. Headline (thesis of the page).
22: 2. Subtext (supporting the headline).
23: 3. CTA (primary action).
24: 4. Optional: secondary action or supporting visual.
25: 
26: ---
27: 
28: # Layout
29: 
30: - Hero must be visible above the fold.
31: - Never hide the CTA below the fold.
32: - Use `text-wrap: balance` on the headline.
33: - Use `text-wrap: pretty` on subtext.
34: - Body text: `max-w-[65ch]`.
35: 
36: ---
37: 
38: # Anti-Patterns
39: 
40: - Hero with more than 4 text elements.
41: - CTA pushed below the fold by excessive padding.
42: - Headline that spans more than 2 lines.
43: - Subtext that exceeds 20 words.
44: - Hero with no clear visual hierarchy.
45: - Generic "Welcome to [Framework]" boilerplate.
46: 
47: ---
48: 
49: # Design Variance
50: 
51: - Hero should set the tone for the entire page.
52: - At least one asymmetric element in the hero.
53: - Break the grid intentionally.
54: - Use the three dials to calibrate hero intensity.
55: 
56: ---
57: 
58: # Sources
59: 
60: - Taste Skill v2 (Leon Lin) - Hero constraints and Section 14 pre-flight.
`````

## File: docs/rules/Taste Skill Color Rules.md
`````markdown
 1: # Taste Skill Color Rules
 2: 
 3: Color system rules adapted from the Taste Skill framework.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # One Accent Per Page
 8: 
 9: - Every page has exactly one accent color.
10: - The accent color is used for CTAs, active states, and highlights.
11: - Never use multiple accent colors on a single page.
12: 
13: ---
14: 
15: # Color Palette
16: 
17: - Define a 4-6 value named hex palette per project.
18: - Use oklch color space in `globals.css` for perceptually uniform colors.
19: - Never use default Tailwind colors without customization.
20: - Never use purple-to-blue gradients as a default.
21: 
22: ---
23: 
24: # Banned Palettes
25: 
26: - Warm cream (#F4F1EA) with serif display and terracotta accent.
27: - Near-black with acid-green or vermilion accents.
28: - Purple-to-blue gradient backgrounds.
29: - Broad hairline-rule layouts with serif typography.
30: 
31: ---
32: 
33: # Radius Scale
34: 
35: - One radius scale per page.
36: - Define in `globals.css` via CSS custom properties.
37: - Concentric radius formula: outer radius = inner radius + padding.
38: - Never mix radius scales within a page.
39: 
40: ---
41: 
42: # Theme Locks
43: 
44: - One theme (light or dark) per page.
45: - Switch themes at the layout level, not per component.
46: - Test both themes before shipping.
47: 
48: ---
49: 
50: # Token Usage
51: 
52: - Always use design tokens from `globals.css`.
53: - Never hardcode color values in Tailwind classes.
54: - Update tokens at the source, not in individual components.
55: 
56: ---
57: 
58: # Sources
59: 
60: - Taste Skill v2 (Leon Lin) - Color/Shape/Page-Theme locks.
61: - W3C Design Tokens Community Group - First stable specification.
`````

## File: docs/rules/Vercel Interface Rule Categories.md
`````markdown
  1: # Vercel Interface Rule Categories
  2: 
  3: Performance and accessibility rules adapted from Vercel's web design guidelines.
  4: 
  5: ---
  6: 
  7: # Accessibility
  8: 
  9: - Icon-only buttons need `aria-label`.
 10: - Never use `outline-none` without a focus replacement.
 11: - Never block paste on password or input fields.
 12: - Honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
 13: - Use semantic HTML elements.
 14: - Ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA.
 15: 
 16: ---
 17: 
 18: # Focus Management
 19: 
 20: - Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.
 21: - Focus should follow logical tab order.
 22: - Skip links for keyboard navigation.
 23: - Focus trapping in modals and dialogs.
 24: 
 25: ---
 26: 
 27: # Forms
 28: 
 29: - Labels associated with inputs.
 30: - Error messages linked to inputs via `aria-describedby`.
 31: - Required fields indicated visually and programmatically.
 32: - Inline validation on blur, not on every keystroke.
 33: - Never clear form state on accidental navigation.
 34: 
 35: ---
 36: 
 37: # Animation
 38: 
 39: - Always honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
 40: - Keep animations under 300ms for micro-interactions.
 41: - Use `ease-out` for enter, `ease-in` for exit.
 42: - Virtualize lists over 50 items.
 43: - Avoid layout-triggering animations (use `transform` and `opacity`).
 44: 
 45: ---
 46: 
 47: # Typography
 48: 
 49: - Use `text-wrap: balance` on headlines.
 50: - Use `text-wrap: pretty` on body text.
 51: - Line length: 45-90 characters.
 52: - Consistent type scale across the application.
 53: 
 54: ---
 55: 
 56: # Content
 57: 
 58: - Use `Intl.DateTimeFormat` for dates.
 59: - Destructive actions need confirmation or undo.
 60: - URL should reflect application state.
 61: - Loading states for all async operations.
 62: 
 63: ---
 64: 
 65: # Images
 66: 
 67: - Explicit `width` and `height` on all images.
 68: - Use `next/image` for optimized delivery.
 69: - Alt text on all meaningful images.
 70: - Decorative images: `alt=""` and `role="presentation"`.
 71: 
 72: ---
 73: 
 74: # Performance
 75: 
 76: - Server Components by default.
 77: - Lazy load below-the-fold content.
 78: - Minimize client-side JavaScript.
 79: - Use streaming and Suspense boundaries.
 80: - Prefetch critical navigation links.
 81: 
 82: ---
 83: 
 84: # Touch
 85: 
 86: - Minimum 40x40px touch targets.
 87: - Avoid hover-only interactions on touch devices.
 88: - Use `@media (hover: hover)` for hover styles.
 89: - Safe areas for mobile notches.
 90: 
 91: ---
 92: 
 93: # Dark Mode
 94: 
 95: - Use CSS custom properties for theme switching.
 96: - Test both light and dark modes.
 97: - Avoid pure black (#000) for backgrounds. Use dark grays.
 98: - Ensure sufficient contrast in both modes.
 99: 
100: ---
101: 
102: # Sources
103: 
104: - Vercel web-interface-guidelines (MIT).
105: - Vercel web-design-guidelines agent skill.
106: - vercel.com/design/guidelines.
`````

`````markdown
 1: # Impeccable Toolchain
 2: 
 3: Automated visual and engineering defect detection for AI-generated frontend code.

 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Overview
 8: 
 9: - 23 commands organized by discipline.
10: - 45 deterministic anti-pattern rules.
11: - Runs without an LLM for detection.

14: ---

18: ```bash
19: npx impeccable install
20: ```
21: 
22: Then inside your AI coding tool:
23: 
24: ```
25: /impeccable init
26: ```
27: 
28: This creates `PRODUCT.md` and optionally `DESIGN.md`.
29: 
30: ---
31: 
32: # Key Commands
33: 
34: | Command                | Purpose                                          |
35: | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
36: | `/impeccable init`     | Initialize project with PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md |
37: | `/impeccable detect`   | Run 45-rule detector                             |
38: | `/impeccable bolder`   | Respect existing design systems                  |
39: | `/impeccable critique` | Independent critique mode                        |

72: - Decorative grid backgrounds.

77: # Detector Rules (45)

81: - Typography violations.
`````

## File: docs/skills/Make Interfaces Feel Better.md
`````markdown
 1: # Make Interfaces Feel Better
 2: 
 3: Micro-interaction and visual polish skill by Jakub Krehel.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Overview
 8: 
 9: 16 rule categories for improving interface feel through precise micro-interactions, shadows, typography, and animation values.
10: 
11: ---
12: 
13: # Key Rules
14: 
15: ## Concentric Border Radius
16: 
17: Outer radius = inner radius + padding.
18: 
19: Example: card with 16px padding and 8px inner radius gets 24px outer radius.
20: 
21: ## Optical Alignment
22: 
23: Elements should appear visually centered, not mathematically centered.
24: 
25: Adjust for optical weight (heavier elements shift slightly toward center).
26: 
27: ## Shadows Over Borders
28: 
29: Compose shadows from three layers:
30: 
31: 1. Ambient (diffuse, large spread).
32: 2. Key (directional, medium spread).
33: 3. Rim (tight, small spread).
34: 
35: Prefer shadows over borders for depth and separation.
36: 
37: ## Press States
38: 
39: Button press feedback: `transform: scale(0.96)`.
40: 
41: Never go below `scale(0.95)`.
42: 
43: ## Hit Areas
44: 
45: Interactive elements: minimum 40x40px hit area.
46: 
47: Extend with pseudo-element when the visible element is smaller.
48: 
49: ## Font Smoothing
50: 
51: Enable: `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`.
52: 
53: Use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` for numeric data.
54: 
55: ## Animation Values
56: 
57: - Icon: `scale 0.25 -> 1`, `opacity 0 -> 1`, `blur 4px -> 0`.
58: - Stagger delay: ~100ms between items.
59: - Enter duration: ~800ms.
60: - Exit: subtler than enter.
61: - Spring settings: `duration 0.3`, `bounce 0`.
62: 
63: ## Image Outlines
64: 
65: - 1px at 10% opacity.
66: - Black in light mode, white in dark mode.
67: 
68: ---
69: 
70: # Supporting Files
71: 
72: - `typography.md` - Typography rules.
73: - `surfaces.md` - Surface and shadow rules.
74: - `animations.md` - Animation value reference.
75: - `performance.md` - Performance constraints.
76: 
77: ---
78: 
79: # Sources
80: 
81: - jakubkrehel/make-interfaces-feel-better (no license, all rights reserved).
82: - jakub.kr/writing/details-that-make-interfaces-feel-better.
`````

## File: docs/skills/Taste Skill Project.md
`````markdown
 1: # Taste Skill Project
 2: 
 3: Three-dial aesthetic framework for calibrating AI-generated frontend output.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Overview
 8: 
 9: The Taste Skill provides a conversation-driven framework for setting aesthetic direction before building. It prevents generic AI output by committing to a direction early.
10: 
11: ---
12: 
13: # The Three Dials
14: 
15: | Dial             | Default | Scale | Description                                      |
16: | ---------------- | ------- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------ |
17: | Design Variance  | 8       | 1-10  | How much the layout breaks from generic patterns |
18: | Motion Intensity | 6       | 1-10  | How much animation and transition is present     |
19: | Visual Density   | 4       | 1-10  | How much information per viewport                |
20: 
21: Set these dials conversationally before touching layout.
22: 
23: ---
24: 
25: # Section 14 Pre-Flight Check
26: 
27: Mandatory before completing any page:
28: 
29: - [ ] Three dials set and committed.
30: - [ ] Hero follows constraints (2-line headline, 20-word subtext, CTA above fold).
31: - [ ] Navigation on single line at desktop (80px height cap).
32: - [ ] One accent color per page.
33: - [ ] One radius scale per page.
34: - [ ] One theme per page.
35: - [ ] At least 4 layout families in 8-section pages.
36: - [ ] No em-dashes or en-dashes in visible text.
37: - [ ] No cards nested inside cards.
38: - [ ] No purple-to-blue gradients.
39: - [ ] No Inter for everything without justification.
40: - [ ] Typography uses balance/pretty wrapping.
41: 
42: Any failed box blocks completion.
43: 
44: ---
45: 
46: # Greenfield Workflow
47: 
48: 1. Set the three dials.
49: 2. Pick a 4-6 value named hex palette.
50: 3. Define the hero thesis.
51: 4. Build with committed direction.
52: 5. Run Section 14 pre-flight.
53: 6. Revise if any check fails.
54: 
55: ---
56: 
57: # Redesign Workflow
58: 
59: 1. Audit existing interface against Section 14.
60: 2. Identify what to preserve, what to overhaul.
61: 3. Set the three dials for the new direction.
62: 4. Build respecting preserved elements.
63: 5. Run Section 14 pre-flight.
64: 
65: ---
66: 
67: # Anti-Laziness Rules
68: 
69: - Never output a generic layout as a starting point.
70: - Always commit to a direction before building.
71: - Always run the pre-flight check.
72: - Never skip the critique pass.
73: 
74: ---
75: 
76: # Sources
77: 
78: - Leonxlnx/taste-skill (MIT).
79: - tasteskill.dev.
80: - v2 is experimental, iterating toward v2.0.0 stable.
`````

`````typescript
 1: import "dotenv/config";
 2: import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
 3: import { PrismaNeon } from "@prisma/adapter-neon";
 4: import { neonConfig } from "@neondatabase/serverless";
 5: import ws from "ws";
 6: neonConfig.webSocketConstructor = ws;
 7: const connectionString = process.env.DIRECT_URL || process.env.DATABASE_URL;
 8: const adapter = connectionString
 9:   ? new PrismaNeon({ connectionString })
10:   : undefined;
11: const prisma = adapter ? new PrismaClient({ adapter }) : new PrismaClient();
12: export async function seedLmsRolesAndPermissions() {
13:   const permissions = [
14:     {
15:       name: "roles:assign",
16:       description: "Assign and manage user roles",
17:       resource: "role",
18:       action: "assign",
19:     },
20:   ];
21:   for (const perm of permissions) {
22:     await prisma.permission.upsert({
23:       where: { name: perm.name },
24:       update: { description: perm.description },
25:       create: perm,
26:     });
27:   }
28:   const roles = [
29:     {
30:       name: "student",
31:       description: "Student persona enrolled in courses",
32:       permissions: [],
33:     },
34:     {
35:       name: "instructor",
36:       description: "Instructor persona who creates and manages courses",
37:       permissions: [],
38:     },
39:     {
40:       name: "admin",
41:       description: "Platform administrator with full role management authority",
42:       permissions: ["roles:assign"],
43:     },
44:   ];
45:   for (const r of roles) {
46:     const role = await prisma.role.upsert({
47:       where: { name: r.name },
48:       update: { description: r.description },
49:       create: { name: r.name, description: r.description },
50:     });
51:     for (const permName of r.permissions) {
52:       const perm = await prisma.permission.findUnique({
53:         where: { name: permName },
54:       });
55:       if (perm) {
56:         await prisma.rolePermission.upsert({
57:           where: {
58:             roleId_permissionId: {
59:               roleId: role.id,
60:               permissionId: perm.id,
61:             },
62:           },
63:           update: {},
64:           create: {
65:             roleId: role.id,
66:             permissionId: perm.id,
67:           },
68:         });
69:       }
70:     }
71:   }
72: }
73: async function main() {
74:   console.log("Seeding LMS roles and permissions...");
75:   await seedLmsRolesAndPermissions();
76:   console.log("Seeding completed successfully.");
77: }
78: if (require.main === module) {
79:   main()
80:     .catch((e) => {
81:       console.error("Seeding error:", e);
82:       process.exit(1);
83:     })
84:     .finally(async () => {
85:       await prisma.$disconnect();
86:     });
87: }
`````

`````typescript
56: ): Promise<ActionResult<progressService.CourseProgressDetail>> {
57:   try {
58:     const session = await requireAuth();
59:     const parsedId = courseIdSchema.safeParse(courseId);
60:     if (!parsedId.success) {
61:       const firstMessage =
62:         parsedId.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid course ID";
63:       return actionFailure(firstMessage, "VALIDATION_ERROR");
64:     }
65:     const progress = await progressService.getCourseProgress(
66:       session.user.id,
67:       parsedId.data,
68:     );
69:     return actionSuccess(progress);
70:   } catch (error) {
71:     return handleActionError(error, "Failed to retrieve course progress");
72:   }
73: }
74: export async function getNextLessonAction(
75:   courseId: unknown,
76: ): Promise<ActionResult<progressService.NextLessonResult | null>> {
77:   try {
78:     const session = await requireAuth();
79:     const parsedId = courseIdSchema.safeParse(courseId);
80:     if (!parsedId.success) {
81:       const firstMessage =
82:         parsedId.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid course ID";
83:       return actionFailure(firstMessage, "VALIDATION_ERROR");
84:     }
85:     const nextLesson = await progressService.getNextLesson(
86:       session.user.id,
87:       parsedId.data,
88:     );
89:     return actionSuccess(nextLesson);
90:   } catch (error) {
91:     return handleActionError(error, "Failed to retrieve next lesson");
92:   }
93: }
`````

## File: src/app/courses/[slug]/learn/page.tsx
`````typescript
 1: import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
 2: import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth-helpers";
 3: import { getCourseOverview } from "@/services/course";
 4: import { getNextLesson } from "@/services/progress";
 5: import { hasRole } from "@/services/authorization";
 6: import { NotFoundError } from "@/lib/errors";
 7: interface LearnRedirectPageProps {
 8:   params: Promise<{
 9:     slug: string;
10:   }>;
11: }
12: export default async function LearnRedirectPage({
13:   params,
14: }: LearnRedirectPageProps) {
15:   const { slug } = await params;
16:   const user = await getCurrentUser();
17:   let overviewData: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getCourseOverview>>;
18:   try {
19:     overviewData = await getCourseOverview(slug, user?.id);
20:   } catch (error) {
21:     if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
22:       notFound();
23:     }
24:     throw error;
25:   }
26:   const { course, modules, isEnrolled, totalLessons } = overviewData;
27:   if (totalLessons === 0 || modules.length === 0) {
28:     redirect(`/courses/${slug}`);
29:   }
30:   const firstLesson = modules[0]?.lessons[0];
31:   if (!firstLesson) {
32:     redirect(`/courses/${slug}`);
33:   }
34:   let firstPreviewLesson: { id: string } | null = null;
35:   for (const mod of modules) {
36:     const preview = mod.lessons.find((l) => l.isFreePreview);
37:     if (preview) {
38:       firstPreviewLesson = preview;
39:       break;
40:     }
41:   }
42:   const isOwner = user ? course.instructorId === user.id : false;
43:   const isAdmin = user ? await hasRole(user.id, "admin") : false;
44:   if (isOwner || isAdmin) {
45:     redirect(`/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson.id}`);
46:   }
47:   if (user && isEnrolled) {
48:     const next = await getNextLesson(user.id, course.id);
49:     if (next) {
50:       redirect(`/courses/${slug}/lessons/${next.id}`);
51:     } else {
52:       redirect(`/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson.id}`);
53:     }
54:   }
55:   if (firstPreviewLesson) {
56:     redirect(`/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstPreviewLesson.id}`);
57:   }
58:   redirect(`/courses/${slug}`);
59: }
`````

`````typescript
 47: export default async function LessonPlayerPage({ params }: PlayerPageProps) {
 48:   const { slug, lessonId } = await params;
 49:   const user = await getCurrentUser();
 50:   let playerData: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getCourseLessonForPlayer>>;
 51:   try {
 52:     playerData = await getCourseLessonForPlayer({
 53:       courseSlug: slug,
 54:       lessonId,
 55:       userId: user?.id,
 56:     });
 57:   } catch (error) {
 58:     if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
 59:       notFound();
 60:     }
 61:     if (
 62:       error instanceof AuthorizationError ||
 63:       error instanceof AuthenticationError
 64:     ) {
 65:       redirect(`/courses/${slug}?enrolled=false`);
 66:     }
 67:     throw error;
 68:   }
 69:   const { course, lesson, navigation } = playerData;
 70:   const overviewData = await getCourseOverview(slug, user?.id);
 71:   const isOwner = user ? course.instructorId === user.id : false;
 72:   const isAdmin = user ? await hasRole(user.id, "admin") : false;
 73:   const canAccessCourse = isOwner || isAdmin;
 74:   const canTrackProgress = Boolean(
 75:     user && (overviewData.isEnrolled || canAccessCourse),
 76:   );
 77:   const isLessonCompleted = overviewData.completedLessonIds.includes(lessonId);
 78:   const completedCount = overviewData.completedLessonIds.length;
 79:   const totalLessons = overviewData.totalLessons;
 80:   const progressPercentage =
 81:     totalLessons > 0 ? Math.round((completedCount / totalLessons) * 100) : 0;
 82:   return (
 83:     <PlayerProvider>
 84:       <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background text-foreground">
 85:         {}
 86:         <PlayerHeader
 87:           courseTitle={course.title}
 88:           courseSlug={slug}
 89:           lessonTitle={lesson.lessonTitle}
 90:         />
 91:         {}
 92:         <div className="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
 93:           <PlayerSidebar
 94:             courseSlug={slug}
 95:             courseTitle={course.title}
 96:             modules={overviewData.modules}
 97:             currentLessonId={lessonId}
 98:             progressPercentage={progressPercentage}
 99:             completedLessons={completedCount}
100:             totalLessons={totalLessons}
101:             isEnrolled={overviewData.isEnrolled}
102:             canAccessCourse={canAccessCourse}
103:           />
104:           <main
105:             className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-12"
106:             style={{ height: "calc(100vh - 7rem)" }}
107:           >
108:             <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-4xl flex-col gap-6">
109:               {}
110:               {lesson.videoUrl && (

112:                   videoUrl={lesson.videoUrl}
113:                   lessonTitle={lesson.lessonTitle}
114:                 />
115:               )}
116:               {}
117:               <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-border/50 pb-4">
118:                 <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
119:                   <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary">
120:                     Lesson {navigation.currentIndex} of{" "}
121:                     {navigation.totalLessons}
122:                   </span>
123:                   {lesson.isFreePreview && (
124:                     <Badge
125:                       variant="secondary"
126:                       className="px-2 py-0 text-[10px] font-medium bg-primary/10 text-primary"
127:                     >
128:                       Free Preview
129:                     </Badge>
130:                   )}
131:                   {overviewData.course.level && (
132:                     <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">
133:                       {overviewData.course.level}
134:                     </Badge>
135:                   )}
136:                 </div>
137:                 <h1 className="font-heading text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground text-balance sm:text-2xl">
138:                   {lesson.lessonTitle}
139:                 </h1>
140:               </div>
141:               {}
142:               <div className="py-2">
143:                 <PlayerContent bodyHtml={lesson.bodyHtml} />
144:               </div>
145:               {}
146:               {lesson.resources.length > 0 && (
147:                 <div className="pt-4">
148:                   <PlayerResources resources={lesson.resources} />
149:                 </div>
150:               )}
151:             </div>
152:           </main>
153:         </div>
154:         {}
155:         <PlayerFooter
156:           courseSlug={slug}
157:           lessonId={lessonId}
158:           previousLesson={navigation.previousLesson}
159:           nextLesson={navigation.nextLesson}
160:           isCompleted={isLessonCompleted}
161:           canTrackProgress={canTrackProgress}
162:           currentIndex={navigation.currentIndex}
163:           totalLessons={navigation.totalLessons}
164:         />
165:       </div>
166:     </PlayerProvider>
167:   );
168: }
`````

## File: src/components/features/auth/sign-in-form.tsx
`````typescript
  1: "use client";
  2: import * as React from "react";
  3: import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
  4: import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
  5: import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
  6: import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";
  7: import { signInSchema, type SignInInput } from "@/lib/validations/auth";
  8: import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
  9: import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
 10: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
 11: import { gooeyToast } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster";
 12: import { AlertCircle, Eye, EyeOff, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
 13: export function SignInForm() {
 14:   const router = useRouter();
 15:   const searchParams = useSearchParams();
 16:   const callbackUrl = searchParams.get("callbackUrl");
 17:   const [serverError, setServerError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
 18:   const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = React.useState(false);
 19:   const {
 20:     register,
 21:     handleSubmit,
 22:     formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
 23:   } = useForm<SignInInput>({
 24:     resolver: zodResolver(signInSchema),
 25:     defaultValues: {
 26:       email: "",
 27:       password: "",
 28:     },
 29:   });
 30:   const onSubmit = async (data: SignInInput) => {
 31:     setServerError(null);
 32:     try {
 33:       const response = await authClient.signIn.email({
 34:         email: data.email,
 35:         password: data.password,
 36:       });
 37:       if (response.error) {
 38:         const errorMsg =
 39:           response.error.message ||
 40:           "Invalid email or password. Please try again.";
 41:         setServerError(errorMsg);
 42:         gooeyToast.error(errorMsg);
 43:         return;
 44:       }
 45:       gooeyToast.success("Signed in successfully!");
 46:       // Resolve destination safely
 47:       const targetUrl =
 48:         callbackUrl?.startsWith("/") && !callbackUrl.startsWith("
 49:           ? callbackUrl
 50:           : "/courses";
 51:       router.push(targetUrl);
 52:       router.refresh();
 53:     } catch {
 54:       const genericError = "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.";
 55:       setServerError(genericError);
 56:       gooeyToast.error(genericError);
 57:     }
 58:   };
 59:   return (
 60:     <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4">
 61:       {serverError && (
 62:         <div
 63:           role="alert"
 64:           className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/10 p-3.5 text-sm text-destructive"
 65:         >
 66:           <AlertCircle className="size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
 67:           <span>{serverError}</span>
 68:         </div>
 69:       )}
 70:       {}
 71:       <div className="space-y-1.5">
 72:         <Label htmlFor="email" className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
 73:           Email Address
 74:         </Label>
 75:         <Input
 76:           id="email"
 77:           type="email"
 78:           autoComplete="email"
 79:           placeholder="you@example.com"
 80:           {...register("email")}
 81:           aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)}
 82:           className="h-10"
 83:         />
 84:         {errors.email && (
 85:           <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.email.message}</p>
 86:         )}
 87:       </div>
 88:       {}
 89:       <div className="space-y-1.5">
 90:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 91:           <Label
 92:             htmlFor="password"
 93:             className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground"
 94:           >
 95:             Password
 96:           </Label>
 97:         </div>
 98:         <div className="relative">
 99:           <Input
100:             id="password"
101:             type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
102:             autoComplete="current-password"
103:             placeholder="••••••••"
104:             {...register("password")}
105:             aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.password)}
106:             className="h-10 pr-10"
107:           />
108:           <button
109:             type="button"
110:             className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground absolute top-1/2 right-3 -translate-y-1/2 cursor-pointer p-1 transition-colors"
111:             onClick={() => setShowPassword((prev) => !prev)}
112:             aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
113:           >
114:             {showPassword ? (
115:               <EyeOff className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
116:             ) : (
117:               <Eye className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
118:             )}
119:           </button>
120:         </div>
121:         {errors.password && (
122:           <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.password.message}</p>
123:         )}
124:       </div>
`````

`````typescript
  1: "use client";
  2: import * as React from "react";
`````

`````typescript
  8: import { BookOpen, LayoutDashboard, LogOut, Settings } from "lucide-react";
  9: export function UserNav() {
 10:   const router = useRouter();
 11:   const { data: session, isPending } = authClient.useSession();
 12:   const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = React.useState(false);
 13:   const menuRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
 14:   React.useEffect(() => {
 15:     function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
 16:       if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
 17:         setIsOpen(false);
 18:       }
 19:     }
 20:     if (isOpen) {
 21:       document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
 22:     }
 23:     return () => {
 24:       document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
 25:     };
 26:   }, [isOpen]);
 27:   React.useEffect(() => {
 28:     function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 29:       if (event.key === "Escape") {
 30:         setIsOpen(false);
 31:       }
 32:     }
 33:     if (isOpen) {
 34:       document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
 35:     }
 36:     return () => {
 37:       document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
 38:     };
 39:   }, [isOpen]);
 40:   if (isPending) {
 41:     return (
 42:       <div className="size-8 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-muted ring-1 ring-border" />
 43:     );
 44:   }
 45:   if (!session?.user) {
 46:     return null;
 47:   }
 48:   const user = session.user;
 49:   const initials = user.name
 50:     ? user.name
 51:         .split(" ")
 52:         .map((n) => n[0])
 53:         .join("")
 54:         .slice(0, 2)
 55:         .toUpperCase()
 56:     : "U";
 57:   const handleSignOut = async () => {
 58:     try {
 59:       await authClient.signOut();
 60:       gooeyToast.success("Signed out successfully");
 61:       setIsOpen(false);
 62:       router.push("/sign-in");
 63:       router.refresh();
 64:     } catch {
 65:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to sign out");
 66:     }
 67:   };
 68:   return (
 69:     <div className="relative" ref={menuRef}>
 70:       <button
 71:         type="button"
 72:         onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
 73:         className="flex size-9 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 font-semibold text-xs text-primary ring-1 ring-primary/20 transition-all hover:ring-primary/40 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring active:scale-[0.96]"
 74:         aria-expanded={isOpen}
 75:         aria-haspopup="menu"
 76:         aria-label="User navigation menu"
 77:       >
 78:         {user.image ? (
 79:           <Image
 80:             src={user.image}
 81:             alt={user.name || "User avatar"}
 82:             width={36}
 83:             height={36}
 84:             className="size-full rounded-full object-cover"
 85:           />
 86:         ) : (
 87:           <span>{initials}</span>
 88:         )}
 89:       </button>
 90:       {isOpen && (
 91:         <div
 92:           role="menu"
 93:           aria-orientation="vertical"
 94:           className="absolute right-0 z-50 mt-2 w-56 origin-top-right rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-1 text-card-foreground shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5 animate-in fade-in-50 zoom-in-95 duration-100"
 95:         >
 96:           {}
 97:           <div className="border-border border-b px-3 py-2.5">
 98:             <p className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
 99:               {user.name || "My Account"}
100:             </p>
101:             <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
102:               {user.email}
103:             </p>
104:           </div>
105:           {}
106:           <div className="py-1">
107:             <Link
108:               href="/courses"
109:               onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
110:               className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
111:               role="menuitem"
112:             >
113:               <BookOpen className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
114:               <span>Browse Courses</span>
115:             </Link>
116:             <Link
117:               href="/instructor/courses"
118:               onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
119:               className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
120:               role="menuitem"
121:             >
122:               <LayoutDashboard className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
123:               <span>Instructor Workspace</span>
124:             </Link>
125:             <Link
126:               href="/settings/profile"
127:               onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
128:               className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
129:               role="menuitem"
130:             >
131:               <Settings className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />

135:           <div className="border-border border-t py-1">

139:               className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs text-destructive transition-colors hover:bg-destructive/10"
140:               role="menuitem"
`````

## File: src/components/features/catalog/course-pagination.tsx
`````typescript
 1: import Link from "next/link";
 2: import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
 3: export interface CoursePaginationProps {
 4:   currentPage: number;
 5:   totalPages: number;
 6:   searchParams?: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
 7: }
 8: export function CoursePagination({
 9:   currentPage,
10:   totalPages,
11:   searchParams = {},
12: }: CoursePaginationProps) {
13:   if (totalPages <= 1) return null;
14:   const createPageUrl = (page: number) => {
15:     const params = new URLSearchParams();
16:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(searchParams)) {
17:       if (value && key !== "page") {
18:         if (Array.isArray(value)) {
19:           for (const v of value) params.append(key, v);
20:         } else {
21:           params.set(key, value);
22:         }
23:       }
24:     }
25:     params.set("page", String(page));
26:     return `/courses?${params.toString()}`;
27:   };
28:   const pages: number[] = [];
29:   const startPage = Math.max(1, currentPage - 2);
30:   const endPage = Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 2);
31:   for (let i = startPage; i <= endPage; i++) {
32:     pages.push(i);
33:   }
34:   return (
35:     <nav
36:       className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 pt-6 pb-2"
37:       aria-label="Course catalog pagination"
38:     >
39:       {}
40:       {currentPage > 1 ? (
41:         <Link
42:           href={createPageUrl(currentPage - 1)}
43:           className="border-input bg-background hover:bg-muted text-foreground inline-flex min-h-10 min-w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-md border text-sm font-medium transition-transform active:scale-[0.96] motion-reduce:transform-none"
44:           aria-label="Go to previous page"
45:         >
46:           <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
47:         </Link>
48:       ) : (
49:         <span
50:           className="border-input/50 text-muted-foreground/40 inline-flex min-h-10 min-w-10 cursor-not-allowed items-center justify-center rounded-md border text-sm"
51:           aria-disabled="true"
52:         >
53:           <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
54:         </span>
55:       )}
56:       {}
57:       {pages.map((p) => {
58:         const isCurrent = p === currentPage;
59:         return isCurrent ? (
60:           <span
61:             key={p}
62:             className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground inline-flex min-h-10 min-w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-semibold shadow-xs tabular-nums"
63:             aria-current="page"
64:           >
65:             {p}
66:           </span>
67:         ) : (
68:           <Link
69:             key={p}
70:             href={createPageUrl(p)}
71:             className="border-input bg-background hover:bg-muted text-foreground inline-flex min-h-10 min-w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-md border text-sm font-medium transition-transform tabular-nums active:scale-[0.96] motion-reduce:transform-none"
72:             aria-label={`Go to page ${p}`}
73:           >
74:             {p}
75:           </Link>
76:         );
77:       })}
78:       {}
79:       {currentPage < totalPages ? (
80:         <Link
81:           href={createPageUrl(currentPage + 1)}
82:           className="border-input bg-background hover:bg-muted text-foreground inline-flex min-h-10 min-w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-md border text-sm font-medium transition-transform active:scale-[0.96] motion-reduce:transform-none"
83:           aria-label="Go to next page"
84:         >
85:           <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
86:         </Link>
87:       ) : (
88:         <span
89:           className="border-input/50 text-muted-foreground/40 inline-flex min-h-10 min-w-10 cursor-not-allowed items-center justify-center rounded-md border text-sm"
90:           aria-disabled="true"
91:         >
92:           <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
93:         </span>
94:       )}
95:     </nav>
96:   );
97: }
`````

`````typescript
 33: }
 34: function createResourceId(): string {
 35:   if (
 36:     typeof crypto !== "undefined" &&
 37:     typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
 38:   ) {
 39:     return crypto.randomUUID();
 40:   }
 41:   return `res-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 11)}-${Date.now()}`;
 42: }
 43: const serializeResources = (items: EditorResourceItem[]): ResourceItem[] =>
 44:   items.map(({ name, url }) => ({ name, url }));
 45: export interface LessonContentEditorProps {
 46:   lessonId: string;
 47:   initialData?: {
 48:     bodyMarkdown?: string | null;

 52:   };
 53:   readOnly?: boolean;
 54:   onSaveSuccess?: (data: LessonContent) => void;
 55: }
 56: type SaveStatus = "saved" | "saving" | "unsaved" | "error";
 57: export function LessonContentEditor({
 58:   lessonId,
 59:   initialData,
 60:   readOnly = false,
 61:   onSaveSuccess,
 62: }: LessonContentEditorProps) {
 63:   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"write" | "preview">("write");
 64:   const [bodyMarkdown, setBodyMarkdown] = useState(
 65:     initialData?.bodyMarkdown ?? "",
 66:   );

 68:   const [videoUrlInput, setVideoUrlInput] = useState(
 69:     initialData?.videoUrl ?? "",
 70:   );
 71:   const [resources, setResources] = useState<EditorResourceItem[]>(() =>
 72:     (initialData?.resources ?? []).map((res) => ({
 73:       ...res,
 74:       id: createResourceId(),
 75:     })),
 76:   );
 77:   const [saveStatus, setSaveStatus] = useState<SaveStatus>("saved");
 78:   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
 79:   const videoEmbedUrl = useMemo(() => {
 80:     if (!videoUrlInput.trim()) return "";
 81:     try {
 82:       return normalizeVideoUrl(videoUrlInput);
 83:     } catch {
 84:       return null;
 85:     }
 86:   }, [videoUrlInput]);
 87:   // Sequential Autosave Queue refs
 88:   const sequenceRef = useRef(0);
 89:   const isSavingRef = useRef(false);
 90:   const pendingPayloadRef = useRef<{
 91:     lessonId: string;
 92:     bodyMarkdown: string;
 93:     videoUrl: string;
 94:     resources: ResourceItem[];
 95:   } | null>(null);
 96:   const executeSave = useCallback(
 97:     async (initialPayload: {
 98:       lessonId: string;
 99:       bodyMarkdown: string;
100:       videoUrl: string;
101:       resources: ResourceItem[];
102:     }) => {
103:       isSavingRef.current = true;
104:       setSaveStatus("saving");
105:       setErrorMessage(null);
106:       let currentPayload: typeof initialPayload | null = initialPayload;
107:       while (currentPayload) {
108:         const payload = currentPayload;
109:         currentPayload = null;
110:         pendingPayloadRef.current = null;
111:         const currentSeq = ++sequenceRef.current;
112:         try {
113:           const result = await updateLessonContentAction({
114:             lessonId: payload.lessonId,
115:             bodyMarkdown: payload.bodyMarkdown,
116:             videoUrl: payload.videoUrl,
117:             resources: payload.resources,
118:           });
119:           if (currentSeq === sequenceRef.current) {
120:             if (result.success) {
121:               setSaveStatus("saved");
122:               if (result.data.bodyHtml) {
123:                 setPreviewHtml(result.data.bodyHtml);
124:               }
125:               onSaveSuccess?.(result.data);
126:             } else {
127:               setSaveStatus("error");
128:               setErrorMessage(result.error || "Failed to save lesson content.");
129:             }
130:           }
131:         } catch {
132:           if (currentSeq === sequenceRef.current) {
133:             setSaveStatus("error");
134:             setErrorMessage("Network error while saving.");
135:           }
136:         }
137:         if (pendingPayloadRef.current) {
138:           currentPayload = pendingPayloadRef.current;
139:           pendingPayloadRef.current = null;
140:         }
141:       }
142:       isSavingRef.current = false;
143:     },
144:     [onSaveSuccess],
145:   );
146:   const requestSave = useCallback(

149:       bodyMarkdown: string;

157:       } else {

159:       }
160:     },
`````

`````typescript
17:   className,
18: }: EnrollmentButtonProps) {
19:   const [isEnrolled, setIsEnrolled] = useState(initialIsEnrolled);
20:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
21:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
22:   const handleEnroll = async () => {
23:     if (isEnrolled || isLoading) return;
24:     setIsLoading(true);
25:     setError(null);
26:     try {
27:       const result = await enrollInCourseAction({ courseId });
28:       if (!result.success) {
29:         setError(result.error);
30:         gooeyToast.error(result.error);
31:         return;
32:       }
33:       setIsEnrolled(true);
34:       gooeyToast.success("Successfully enrolled in course!");
35:       onEnrollSuccess?.();
36:     } catch {
37:       const message = "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.";
38:       setError(message);
39:       gooeyToast.error(message);
40:     } finally {
41:       setIsLoading(false);
42:     }
43:   };
44:   if (isEnrolled) {
45:     return (
46:       <Button
47:         type="button"
48:         variant="outline"
49:         disabled
50:         className={`min-h-10 min-w-10 gap-2 border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 text-primary cursor-default opacity-100 ${
51:           className ?? ""
52:         }`}
53:         aria-label="Already enrolled in this course"
54:       >
55:         <Check className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
56:         <span>Enrolled</span>
57:       </Button>
58:     );
59:   }
60:   return (
61:     <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
62:       <Button
63:         type="button"
64:         onClick={handleEnroll}
65:         disabled={isLoading}
66:         className={`min-h-10 min-w-10 gap-2 transition-transform active:scale-[0.96] motion-reduce:transform-none ${
67:           className ?? ""
68:         }`}
69:         aria-label="Enroll in course"
70:       >
71:         {isLoading ? (
72:           <>
73:             <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
74:             <span>Enrolling...</span>
75:           </>
76:         ) : (
77:           <span>Enroll Now</span>
78:         )}
79:       </Button>
80:       {error && (
81:         <p className="text-xs text-destructive" role="alert">
82:           {error}
83:         </p>
84:       )}
85:     </div>
86:   );
87: }
`````

## File: src/components/features/instructor/course-danger-zone.tsx
`````typescript
  1: "use client";
  2: import * as React from "react";
  3: import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
  4: import { CourseStatus } from "@prisma/client";
  5: import { gooeyToast } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster";
  6: import { archiveCourseAction, deleteCourseAction } from "@/actions/course";
  7: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  8: import { AlertTriangle, Archive, Trash2, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
  9: interface CourseDangerZoneProps {
 10:   courseId: string;
 11:   courseTitle: string;
 12:   status: CourseStatus;
 13: }
 14: export function CourseDangerZone({
 15:   courseId,
 16:   courseTitle,
 17:   status,
 18: }: CourseDangerZoneProps) {
 19:   const router = useRouter();
 20:   const [isArchiving, setIsArchiving] = React.useState(false);
 21:   const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = React.useState(false);
 22:   const handleArchive = async () => {
 23:     const confirmed = window.confirm(
 24:       `Are you sure you want to archive "${courseTitle}"? Students will no longer be able to enroll, and current students will lose access to new updates.`,
 25:     );
 26:     if (!confirmed) return;
 27:     setIsArchiving(true);
 28:     try {
 29:       const result = await archiveCourseAction(courseId);
 30:       if (result.success) {
 31:         gooeyToast.success("Course archived successfully.");
 32:         router.refresh();
 33:       } else {
 34:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to archive course.");
 35:       }
 36:     } catch {
 37:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to archive course. Please try again.");
 38:     } finally {
 39:       setIsArchiving(false);
 40:     }
 41:   };
 42:   const handleDelete = async () => {
 43:     const confirmed = window.confirm(
 44:       `Are you sure you want to permanently delete "${courseTitle}"? This will delete all modules, lessons, and student progress records. This action CANNOT be undone.`,
 45:     );
 46:     if (!confirmed) return;
 47:     setIsDeleting(true);
 48:     try {
 49:       const result = await deleteCourseAction(courseId);
 50:       if (result.success) {
 51:         gooeyToast.success("Course deleted successfully.");
 52:         router.push("/instructor/courses");
 53:       } else {
 54:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to delete course.");
 55:       }
 56:     } catch {
 57:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to delete course. Please try again.");
 58:     } finally {
 59:       setIsDeleting(false);
 60:     }
 61:   };
 62:   const isArchived = status === CourseStatus.ARCHIVED;
 63:   return (
 64:     <div className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-6 shadow-xs">
 65:       <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-destructive">
 66:         <AlertTriangle className="size-5" />
 67:         <h3 className="text-base font-semibold">Danger Zone</h3>
 68:       </div>
 69:       <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-[65ch]">
 70:         These actions are destructive. Please proceed with caution.
 71:       </p>
 72:       <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-4 divide-y divide-destructive/10">
 73:         {}
 74:         <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between pt-2">
 75:           <div>
 76:             <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
 77:               Archive this course
 78:             </h4>
 79:             <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
 80:               {isArchived
 81:                 ? "This course is currently archived."
 82:                 : "Remove course from public view while preserving student records."}
 83:             </p>
 84:           </div>
 85:           <Button
 86:             variant="outline"
 87:             size="sm"
 88:             disabled={isArchiving || isArchived}
 89:             onClick={handleArchive}
 90:             className="min-h-10 min-w-10 active:scale-[0.98] border-destructive/30 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
 91:           >
 92:             {isArchiving ? (
 93:               <Loader2 className="mr-2 size-4 animate-spin" />
 94:             ) : (
 95:               <Archive className="mr-2 size-4" />
 96:             )}
 97:             {isArchived ? "Archived" : "Archive Course"}
 98:           </Button>
 99:         </div>
100:         {}
101:         <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between pt-4">
102:           <div>
103:             <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
104:               Delete this course
105:             </h4>
106:             <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
107:               Permanently remove this course and all its modules and lessons.
108:             </p>
109:           </div>
110:           <Button
111:             variant="destructive"
112:             size="sm"
113:             disabled={isDeleting}
114:             onClick={handleDelete}
115:             className="min-h-10 min-w-10 active:scale-[0.98]"
116:           >
117:             {isDeleting ? (
118:               <Loader2 className="mr-2 size-4 animate-spin" />
119:             ) : (
120:               <Trash2 className="mr-2 size-4" />
121:             )}
122:             Delete Course
123:           </Button>
124:         </div>
125:       </div>
126:     </div>
127:   );
128: }
`````

`````typescript
  1: "use client";
  2: import * as React from "react";
  3: import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
  4: import { CourseStatus } from "@prisma/client";
  5: import { gooeyToast } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster";
  6: import { publishCourseAction, unpublishCourseAction } from "@/actions/course";
  7: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  8: import { Globe, Lock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
  9: interface PublishButtonProps {
 10:   courseId: string;
 11:   status: CourseStatus;
 12:   moduleCount: number;
 13:   lessonCount: number;
 14: }
 15: export function PublishButton({
 16:   courseId,
 17:   status,
 18:   moduleCount,
 19:   lessonCount,
 20: }: PublishButtonProps) {
 21:   const router = useRouter();
 22:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(false);
 23:   const isPublished = status === CourseStatus.PUBLISHED;
 24:   const isArchived = status === CourseStatus.ARCHIVED;
 25:   const handleTogglePublish = async () => {
 26:     if (isArchived) return;
 27:     if (!isPublished) {
 28:       if (moduleCount < 1 || lessonCount < 1) {
 29:         gooeyToast.error(
 30:           "A course must have at least one module and at least one lesson before publishing.",
 31:         );
 32:         return;
 33:       }
 34:       setIsLoading(true);
 35:       try {
 36:         const result = await publishCourseAction(courseId);
 37:         if (result.success) {
 38:           gooeyToast.success(
 39:             "Course published! It is now publicly visible in the catalog.",
 40:           );
 41:           router.refresh();
 42:         } else {
 43:           gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to publish course.");
 44:         }
 45:       } catch {
 46:         gooeyToast.error("Failed to publish course. Please try again.");
 47:       } finally {
 48:         setIsLoading(false);
 49:       }
 50:     } else {
 51:       const confirmed = window.confirm(
 52:         "Unpublishing this course will return it to DRAFT. New students will not be able to find or enroll in it. Do you want to continue?",
 53:       );
 54:       if (!confirmed) return;
 55:       setIsLoading(true);
 56:       try {
 57:         const result = await unpublishCourseAction(courseId);
 58:         if (result.success) {
 59:           gooeyToast.success("Course unpublished and returned to Draft.");
 60:           router.refresh();
 61:         } else {
 62:           gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to unpublish course.");
 63:         }
 64:       } catch {
 65:         gooeyToast.error("Failed to unpublish course. Please try again.");
 66:       } finally {
 67:         setIsLoading(false);
 68:       }
 69:     }
 70:   };
 71:   if (isArchived) {
 72:     return (
 73:       <Button
 74:         variant="outline"
 75:         size="sm"
 76:         disabled
 77:         className="min-h-10 min-w-10 opacity-60 text-xs"
 78:       >
 79:         Archived Course
 80:       </Button>
 81:     );
 82:   }
 83:   return (
 84:     <Button
 85:       variant={isPublished ? "outline" : "default"}
 86:       size="sm"
 87:       disabled={isLoading}
 88:       onClick={handleTogglePublish}
 89:       className={`min-h-10 min-w-10 active:scale-[0.98] font-medium transition-all ${
 90:         isPublished
 91:           ? "border-amber-500/30 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-500/10"
 92:           : "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow-xs"
 93:       }`}
 94:     >
 95:       {isLoading ? (
 96:         <Loader2 className="mr-2 size-4 animate-spin" />
 97:       ) : isPublished ? (
 98:         <Lock className="mr-2 size-4" />
 99:       ) : (
100:         <Globe className="mr-2 size-4" />
101:       )}
102:       {isPublished ? "Unpublish Course" : "Publish Course"}
103:     </Button>
104:   );
105: }
`````

## File: src/components/features/player/player-context.tsx
`````typescript
 1: "use client";
 2: import { createContext, useContext, useMemo, useState } from "react";
 3: interface PlayerContextType {
 4:   isSidebarOpen: boolean;
 5:   openSidebar: () => void;
 6:   closeSidebar: () => void;
 7:   toggleSidebar: () => void;
 8: }
 9: const PlayerContext = createContext<PlayerContextType | null>(null);
10: export function PlayerProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
11:   const [isSidebarOpen, setIsSidebarOpen] = useState(false);
12:   const value = useMemo(
13:     () => ({
14:       isSidebarOpen,
15:       openSidebar: () => setIsSidebarOpen(true),
16:       closeSidebar: () => setIsSidebarOpen(false),
17:       toggleSidebar: () => setIsSidebarOpen((prev) => !prev),
18:     }),
19:     [isSidebarOpen],
20:   );
21:   return (
22:     <PlayerContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</PlayerContext.Provider>
23:   );
24: }
25: export function usePlayerContext() {
26:   const context = useContext(PlayerContext);
27:   if (!context) {
28:     throw new Error("usePlayerContext must be used within a PlayerProvider");
29:   }
30:   return context;
31: }
`````

## File: src/components/features/player/player-resources.tsx
`````typescript
 1: import { Download, ExternalLink, FileText } from "lucide-react";
 2: interface PlayerResourceItem {
 3:   name: string;
 4:   url: string;
 5: }
 6: export interface PlayerResourcesProps {
 7:   resources: PlayerResourceItem[];
 8: }
 9: function isSafeUrl(rawUrl: string): boolean {
10:   try {
11:     const parsed = new URL(rawUrl);
12:     return parsed.protocol === "http:" || parsed.protocol === "https:";
13:   } catch {
14:     return false;
15:   }
16: }
17: export function PlayerResources({ resources }: PlayerResourcesProps) {
18:   const validResources = resources.filter(
19:     (res) => res.name?.trim() && isSafeUrl(res.url),
20:   );
21:   if (validResources.length === 0) {
22:     return null;
23:   }
24:   return (
25:     <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-4 shadow-xs">
26:       <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
27:         <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" aria-hidden="true" />
28:         <h3 className="font-heading text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
29:           Lesson Resources ({validResources.length})
30:         </h3>
31:       </div>
32:       <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
33:         {validResources.map((resource) => (
34:           <li key={resource.url}>
35:             <a
36:               href={resource.url}
37:               target="_blank"
38:               rel="noopener noreferrer"
39:               className="flex min-h-10 items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background/50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-foreground transition-all hover:border-primary/40 hover:bg-muted/40 hover:text-primary active:scale-[0.96] motion-reduce:transform-none focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
40:             >
41:               <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 truncate">
42:                 <Download
43:                   className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground"
44:                   aria-hidden="true"
45:                 />
46:                 <span className="truncate">{resource.name}</span>
47:               </div>
48:               <ExternalLink
49:                 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground/60"
50:                 aria-hidden="true"
51:               />
52:             </a>
53:           </li>
54:         ))}
55:       </ul>
56:     </div>
57:   );
`````

`````typescript
  1: "use client";
`````

`````typescript
  9: import { updateProfileAction } from "@/actions/profile";

 17:     name?: string | null;
 18:     headline?: string | null;
 19:     bio?: string | null;
 20:     website?: string | null;
 21:     avatarUrl?: string | null;
 22:   };
 23: }
 24: export function ProfileForm({ initialData }: ProfileFormProps) {

 26:     type: "success" | "error";
 27:     message: string;
 28:   } | null>(null);

 30:     register,

 39:       website: initialData.website ?? "",

 44:     setFeedback(null);
 45:     try {

 48:         setFeedback({
 49:           type: "success",
 50:           message: "Profile updated successfully.",
 51:         });
 52:       } else {
 53:         setFeedback({
 54:           type: "error",
 55:           message: result.error || "Failed to update profile.",
 56:         });
 57:       }
 58:     } catch {
 59:       setFeedback({
 60:         type: "error",
 61:         message: "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.",
 62:       });
 63:     }
 64:   };
 65:   return (
 66:     <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-6">
 67:       {feedback && (
 68:         <div
 69:           role="alert"
 70:           className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg p-3.5 text-sm ${
 71:             feedback.type === "success"
 72:               ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20"
 73:               : "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border border-destructive/20"
 74:           }`}
 75:         >
 76:           {feedback.type === "success" ? (
 77:             <CheckCircle2 className="size-4 shrink-0" />
 78:           ) : (
 79:             <AlertCircle className="size-4 shrink-0" />
 80:           )}
 81:           <span>{feedback.message}</span>
 82:         </div>
 83:       )}
 84:       <div className="space-y-2">
 85:         <Label htmlFor="name" className="text-sm font-medium">
 86:           Full Name
 87:         </Label>
 88:         <Input
 89:           id="name"
 90:           placeholder="Enter your name"
 91:           aria-invalid={!!errors.name}
 92:           className="min-h-10"
 93:           {...register("name")}
 94:         />
 95:         {errors.name && (
 96:           <p className="text-destructive text-sm">{errors.name.message}</p>
 97:         )}
 98:       </div>
 99:       <div className="space-y-2">
100:         <Label htmlFor="headline" className="text-sm font-medium">
101:           Headline
102:         </Label>
103:         <Input
104:           id="headline"
105:           placeholder="e.g. Senior Software Engineer and Educator"
106:           aria-invalid={!!errors.headline}
107:           className="min-h-10"
108:           {...register("headline")}
109:         />
110:         {errors.headline && (
111:           <p className="text-destructive text-sm">{errors.headline.message}</p>
112:         )}
113:       </div>
114:       <div className="space-y-2">
115:         <Label htmlFor="bio" className="text-sm font-medium">
116:           Biography
117:         </Label>
118:         <Textarea
119:           id="bio"
120:           placeholder="Tell learners about your background and expertise"
121:           aria-invalid={!!errors.bio}
122:           className="min-h-25"
123:           {...register("bio")}
124:         />
125:         {errors.bio && (
126:           <p className="text-destructive text-sm">{errors.bio.message}</p>
127:         )}
128:       </div>
129:       <div className="space-y-2">
130:         <Label htmlFor="website" className="text-sm font-medium">
131:           Website
132:         </Label>
133:         <Input
134:           id="website"
135:           type="url"
136:           placeholder="https://yourwebsite.com"
137:           aria-invalid={!!errors.website}
138:           className="min-h-10"
139:           {...register("website")}
140:         />
141:         {errors.website && (
142:           <p className="text-destructive text-sm">{errors.website.message}</p>
143:         )}
144:       </div>
145:       <div className="space-y-2">
146:         <Label htmlFor="avatarUrl" className="text-sm font-medium">
147:           Avatar URL
148:         </Label>
149:         <Input
150:           id="avatarUrl"
151:           type="url"
152:           placeholder="https://example.com/avatar.jpg"
153:           aria-invalid={!!errors.avatarUrl}
`````

## File: src/components/features/progress/lesson-completion-button.tsx
`````typescript
 1: "use client";
 2: import { useState } from "react";
 3: import { toggleLessonCompletionAction } from "@/actions/progress";
 4: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
 5: import { Check, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
 6: import { gooeyToast } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster";
 7: export interface LessonCompletionButtonProps {
 8:   lessonId: string;
 9:   initialIsCompleted?: boolean;
10:   onToggleSuccess?: (completed: boolean) => void;
11:   className?: string;
12: }
13: export function LessonCompletionButton({
14:   lessonId,
15:   initialIsCompleted = false,
16:   onToggleSuccess,
17:   className,
18: }: LessonCompletionButtonProps) {
19:   const [prevInitial, setPrevInitial] = useState(initialIsCompleted);
20:   const [isCompleted, setIsCompleted] = useState(initialIsCompleted);
21:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
22:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
23:   if (prevInitial !== initialIsCompleted) {
24:     setPrevInitial(initialIsCompleted);
25:     setIsCompleted(initialIsCompleted);
26:   }
27:   const handleToggle = async () => {
28:     if (isLoading) return;
29:     const nextState = !isCompleted;
30:     setIsLoading(true);
31:     setError(null);
32:     try {
33:       const result = await toggleLessonCompletionAction({
34:         lessonId,
35:         completed: nextState,
36:       });
37:       if (!result.success) {
38:         setError(result.error);
39:         gooeyToast.error(result.error);
40:         return;
41:       }
42:       setIsCompleted(result.data.progress.isCompleted);
43:       if (result.data.progress.isCompleted) {
44:         if (result.data.percentage === 100) {
45:           gooeyToast.success("Course 100% Completed! Congratulations! 🎉");
46:         } else {
47:           gooeyToast.success("Lesson marked as complete!");
48:         }
49:       } else {
50:         gooeyToast.info("Lesson marked as incomplete");
51:       }
52:       onToggleSuccess?.(result.data.progress.isCompleted);
53:     } catch {
54:       const message = "Failed to update lesson completion. Please try again.";
55:       setError(message);
56:       gooeyToast.error(message);
57:     } finally {
58:       setIsLoading(false);
59:     }
60:   };
61:   return (
62:     <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
63:       <Button
64:         type="button"
65:         onClick={handleToggle}
66:         disabled={isLoading}
67:         variant={isCompleted ? "outline" : "default"}
68:         className={`min-h-10 min-w-10 gap-2 transition-transform active:scale-[0.96] motion-reduce:transform-none ${
69:           isCompleted
70:             ? "border-emerald-600/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-500/15 hover:text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-500/30 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500/20"
71:             : ""
72:         } ${className ?? ""}`}
73:         aria-pressed={isCompleted}
74:         aria-label={
75:           isCompleted ? "Mark lesson incomplete" : "Mark lesson complete"
76:         }
77:       >
78:         {isLoading ? (
79:           <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
80:         ) : isCompleted ? (
81:           <Check
82:             className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
83:             aria-hidden="true"
84:           />
85:         ) : null}
86:         <span>{isCompleted ? "Completed" : "Mark as Complete"}</span>
87:       </Button>
88:       {error && (
89:         <p className="text-xs text-destructive" role="alert">
90:           {error}
91:         </p>
92:       )}
93:     </div>
94:   );
95: }
`````

## File: src/components/global/theme/mode-toggle.tsx
`````typescript
 1: "use client";
 2: import * as React from "react";
 3: import { Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react";
 4: import { useTheme } from "next-themes";
 5: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
 6: const emptySubscribe = () => () => {};
 7: function ModeToggle(props: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
 8:   const { resolvedTheme, setTheme } = useTheme();
 9:   const mounted = React.useSyncExternalStore(
10:     emptySubscribe,
11:     () => true,
12:     () => false,
13:   );
14:   const isDark = mounted && resolvedTheme === "dark";
15:   const toggleTheme = () => {
16:     if (!mounted) return;
17:     setTheme(isDark ? "light" : "dark");
18:   };
19:   return (
20:     <Button
21:       type="button"
22:       variant="outline"
23:       size="icon"
24:       aria-label={
25:         mounted
26:           ? isDark
27:             ? "Switch to light mode"
28:             : "Switch to dark mode"
29:           : "Toggle theme"
30:       }
31:       title={isDark ? "Switch to light mode" : "Switch to dark mode"}
32:       onClick={toggleTheme}
33:       {...props}
34:     >
35:       <Sun
36:         aria-hidden="true"
37:         className="size-4 scale-100 rotate-0 transition-all dark:scale-0 dark:-rotate-90"
38:       />
39:       <Moon
40:         aria-hidden="true"
41:         className="absolute size-4 scale-0 rotate-90 transition-all dark:scale-100 dark:rotate-0"
42:       />
43:       <span className="sr-only">Toggle theme</span>
44:     </Button>
45:   );
46: }
47: export { ModeToggle };
`````

`````typescript
 1: import { mergeProps } from "@base-ui/react/merge-props";

 3: import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
 4: import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
 5: const badgeVariants = cva(
 6:   "group/badge inline-flex h-5 w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-4xl border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3!",
 7:   {
 8:     variants: {
 9:       variant: {
10:         default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-primary/80",
11:         secondary:
12:           "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-secondary/80",
13:         destructive:
14:           "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 [a]:hover:bg-destructive/20",
15:         outline:
16:           "border-border text-foreground [a]:hover:bg-muted [a]:hover:text-muted-foreground",
17:         ghost:
18:           "hover:bg-muted hover:text-muted-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
19:         link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
20:       },
21:     },
22:     defaultVariants: {
23:       variant: "default",
24:     },
25:   },
26: );
27: function Badge({
28:   className,
29:   variant = "default",
30:   render,
31:   ...props
32: }: useRender.ComponentProps<"span"> & VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants>) {
33:   return useRender({
34:     defaultTagName: "span",
35:     props: mergeProps<"span">(
36:       {
37:         className: cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className),
38:       },
39:       props,
40:     ),
41:     render,
42:     state: {
43:       slot: "badge",
44:       variant,
45:     },
46:   });
47: }
48: export { Badge, badgeVariants };
`````

`````typescript
 1: import { slugify } from "../slug";

 7:     );
 8:   });

10:     expect(slugify("Café au Lait")).toBe("cafe-au-lait");

12:   });
13:   it("preserves non-Latin Unicode scripts natively (e.g. Arabic, Cyrillic, Chinese)", () => {
14:     expect(slugify("تعلم البرمجة")).toBe("تعلم-البرمجة");
15:     expect(slugify("مقدمة إلى لغة TypeScript")).toBe(
16:       "مقدمة-الى-لغة-typescript",
17:     );
18:     expect(slugify("Привет Мир")).toBe("привет-мир");
19:     expect(slugify("你好世界")).toBe("你好世界");
20:   });
21:   it("handles leading, trailing, and repeated whitespace and punctuation", () => {
22:     expect(slugify("   ---Course: Title Here!   ")).toBe("course-title-here");
23:     expect(slugify("multiple   spaces   and---hyphens")).toBe(
24:       "multiple-spaces-and-hyphens",
25:     );
26:   });
27:   it("returns deterministic fallback when input contains only punctuation or symbols", () => {
28:     expect(slugify("???")).toBe("item");
29:     expect(slugify("!@#$%^&*()_+", "course")).toBe("course");
30:     expect(slugify("", "lesson")).toBe("lesson");
31:     expect(slugify("     ", "fallback-slug")).toBe("fallback-slug");
32:   });
33: });
`````
