 1: export type ActionSuccess<T> = {
 2:   success: true;
 3:   data: T;
 4: };
 5: export type ActionFailure = {
 6:   success: false;
 7:   error: string;
 8:   code?: string;
 9:   details?: Record<string, string[]>;
10: };
11: export type ActionResult<T = void> = ActionSuccess<T> | ActionFailure;
12: export function actionSuccess<T>(data: T): ActionSuccess<T> {
13:   return {
14:     success: true,
15:     data,
16:   };
17: }
18: export function actionFailure(
19:   error: string,
20:   code?: string,

  1: import sanitizeHtml from "sanitize-html";
  2: import { marked } from "marked";
  3: const ALLOWED_IFRAME_HOSTNAMES = new Set([
  4:   "youtube.com",
  5:   "www.youtube.com",
  6:   "player.vimeo.com",
  7:   "vimeo.com",
  8:   "loom.com",
  9:   "www.loom.com",
 10: ]);
 11: export const SANITIZER_CONFIG: sanitizeHtml.IOptions = {
 12:   allowedTags: [
 13:     "h1",
 14:     "h2",
 15:     "h3",
 16:     "h4",
 17:     "h5",
 18:     "h6",
 19:     "p",
 20:     "blockquote",
 21:     "pre",
 22:     "code",
 23:     "ul",
 24:     "ol",
 25:     "li",
 26:     "b",
 27:     "i",
 28:     "strong",
 29:     "em",
 30:     "strike",
 31:     "del",
 32:     "hr",
 33:     "table",
 34:     "thead",
 35:     "tbody",
 36:     "tr",
 37:     "th",
 38:     "td",
 39:     "a",
 40:     "img",
 41:     "iframe",
 42:   ],
 43:   allowedAttributes: {
 44:     a: ["href", "name", "target", "rel", "title"],
 45:     img: ["src", "alt", "title", "width", "height"],
 46:     iframe: ["src", "width", "height", "allowfullscreen", "frameborder"],
 47:     code: ["class"],
 48:     pre: ["class"],
 49:     th: ["align"],
 50:     td: ["align"],
 51:   },
 52:   allowedSchemes: ["http", "https", "mailto"],
 53:   allowedSchemesByTag: {
 54:     iframe: ["https"],
 55:     img: ["http", "https"],
 56:   },
 57:   transformTags: {
 58:     a: sanitizeHtml.simpleTransform("a", {
 59:       target: "_blank",
 60:       rel: "noopener noreferrer",
 61:     }),
 62:   },
 63:   exclusiveFilter: (frame) => {
 64:     if (frame.tag === "iframe") {
 65:       const src = frame.attribs.src;
 66:       if (!src) return true;
 67:       try {
 68:         const parsed = new URL(src);
 69:         if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
 70:           return true;
 71:         }
 72:         const hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
 73:         if (!ALLOWED_IFRAME_HOSTNAMES.has(hostname)) {
 74:           return true;
 75:         }
 76:       } catch {
 77:         return true;
 78:       }
 79:     }
 80:     if (frame.tag === "img") {
 81:       const src = frame.attribs.src;
 82:       if (!src) return true;
 83:       try {
 84:         const parsed = new URL(src);
 85:         if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
 86:           return true;
 87:         }
 88:       } catch {
 89:         return true;
 90:       }
 91:     }
 92:     return false;
 93:   },
 94: };
 95: export async function markdownToSanitizedHtml(
 96:   markdown: string,
 97: ): Promise<string> {
 98:   if (!markdown?.trim()) {
 99:     return "";
100:   }
101:   const rawHtml = await marked.parse(markdown, {
102:     gfm: true,
103:     breaks: true,
104:   });
105:   const cleanHtml = sanitizeHtml(rawHtml, SANITIZER_CONFIG);
106:   return cleanHtml;
107: }
`````

## File: src/lib/slug.ts
`````typescript
 1: export function slugify(text: string, fallback = "item"): string {
 2:   const normalized = text
 3:     .normalize("NFKD")
 4:     .replace(/\p{M}/gu, "")
 5:     .toLowerCase()
 6:     .trim();
 7:   const slug = normalized
 8:     .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, "-")
 9:     .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
10:   return slug.length > 0 ? slug : fallback;
11: }
`````

16:   if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
17:     throw new ValidationError("Video URL must use http: or https: scheme");
18:   }
19:   const hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
20:   if (
21:     hostname === "youtube.com" ||
22:     hostname === "www.youtube.com" ||
23:     hostname === "m.youtube.com"
24:   ) {
25:     let videoId: string | null = null;
26:     const pathname = parsed.pathname;
27:     if (pathname === "/watch") {
28:       videoId = parsed.searchParams.get("v");
29:     } else if (pathname.startsWith("/shorts/")) {
30:       const parts = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
31:       videoId = parts[1] ?? null;
32:     } else if (pathname.startsWith("/embed/")) {
33:       const parts = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
34:       videoId = parts[1] ?? null;
35:     }
36:     if (!videoId || !YOUTUBE_ID_REGEX.test(videoId)) {
37:       throw new ValidationError("Invalid or missing YouTube video ID");
38:     }
39:     return `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${videoId}`;
40:   }
41:   if (hostname === "youtu.be") {
42:     const parts = parsed.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
43:     const videoId = parts[0] ?? null;
44:     if (!videoId || !YOUTUBE_ID_REGEX.test(videoId)) {
45:       throw new ValidationError("Invalid or missing YouTube video ID");
46:     }
47:     return `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${videoId}`;
48:   }
49:   if (hostname === "vimeo.com" || hostname === "www.vimeo.com") {
50:     const parts = parsed.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
51:     const videoId = parts[0] ?? null;
52:     if (!videoId || !VIMEO_ID_REGEX.test(videoId)) {
53:       throw new ValidationError("Invalid or missing Vimeo video ID");
54:     }
55:     return `https://player.vimeo.com/video/${videoId}`;
56:   }
57:   if (hostname === "player.vimeo.com") {
58:     const parts = parsed.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
59:     let videoId: string | null = null;
60:     if (parts[0] === "video" && parts[1]) {
61:       videoId = parts[1];
62:     }
63:     if (!videoId || !VIMEO_ID_REGEX.test(videoId)) {
64:       throw new ValidationError("Invalid or missing Vimeo video ID");
65:     }
66:     return `https://player.vimeo.com/video/${videoId}`;
67:   }
68:   if (hostname === "loom.com" || hostname === "www.loom.com") {
69:     const parts = parsed.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
70:     let videoId: string | null = null;
71:     if ((parts[0] === "share" || parts[0] === "embed") && parts[1]) {
72:       videoId = parts[1];
73:     }
74:     if (!videoId || !LOOM_ID_REGEX.test(videoId)) {
75:       throw new ValidationError("Invalid or missing Loom video ID");
76:     }
77:     return `https://www.loom.com/embed/${videoId}`;
78:   }
79:   throw new ValidationError(
80:     "Unsupported video provider. Supported providers are YouTube, Vimeo, and Loom.",
81:   );

341: export async function findPublishedCoursesPaginated(
342:   options: CourseCatalogQueryOptions,
343: ): Promise<PaginatedCoursesResult> {
344:   const page = Math.max(1, options.page ?? 1);
345:   const limit = Math.min(50, Math.max(1, options.limit ?? 12));
346:   const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
347:   const where: Prisma.CourseWhereInput = {
348:     status: CourseStatus.PUBLISHED,
349:   };
350:   if (options.level) {
351:     where.level = options.level;
352:   }
353:   if (options.category?.trim()) {
354:     where.category = options.category.trim();
355:   }
356:   if (options.search?.trim()) {
357:     const term = options.search.trim();
358:     where.OR = [
359:       { title: { contains: term, mode: "insensitive" } },
360:       { description: { contains: term, mode: "insensitive" } },
361:     ];
362:   }
363:   let orderBy: Prisma.CourseOrderByWithRelationInput;
364:   switch (options.sort) {
365:     case "title_asc":
366:       orderBy = { title: "asc" };
367:       break;
368:     case "title_desc":
369:       orderBy = { title: "desc" };
370:       break;
371:     default:
372:       orderBy = { createdAt: "desc" };
373:       break;
374:   }
375:   const [rawCourses, totalCount] = await Promise.all([
376:     prisma.course.findMany({
377:       where,
378:       orderBy,
379:       skip,
380:       take: limit,
381:       include: {
382:         instructor: {
383:           select: {
384:             id: true,
385:             name: true,
386:             image: true,
387:             avatarUrl: true,
388:           },
389:         },
390:         _count: {
391:           select: {
392:             modules: true,
393:             enrollments: true,
394:           },
395:         },
396:       },
397:     }),
398:     prisma.course.count({ where }),
399:   ]);
400:   const courseIds = rawCourses.map((c) => c.id);
401:   const lessonCountsByCourse = new Map<string, number>();
402:   if (courseIds.length > 0) {
403:     const modules = await prisma.module.findMany({
404:       where: { courseId: { in: courseIds } },
405:       select: {
406:         courseId: true,
407:         _count: {
408:           select: { lessons: true },
409:         },
410:       },
411:     });
412:     for (const mod of modules) {
413:       const current = lessonCountsByCourse.get(mod.courseId) ?? 0;
414:       lessonCountsByCourse.set(mod.courseId, current + mod._count.lessons);
415:     }
416:   }
417:   const courses: CatalogCourseRow[] = rawCourses.map((c) => ({
418:     ...c,
419:     totalLessons: lessonCountsByCourse.get(c.id) ?? 0,
420:   }));
421:   const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalCount / limit) || 1;
422:   return {
423:     courses,
424:     totalCount,
425:     page,
426:     limit,
427:     totalPages,
428:   };
429: }

480: export async function executeCourseStatusTransition(
481:   courseId: string,
482:   fromStatuses: CourseStatus[],
483:   toStatus: CourseStatus,
484:   validator?: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<void>,
485: ): Promise<Course> {
486:   return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
487:     const course = await lockCourseForUpdate(tx, courseId);
488:     if (!fromStatuses.includes(course.status)) {
489:       throw new ValidationError(
490:         `Cannot transition course from ${course.status} to ${toStatus}`,
491:       );
492:     }
493:     if (validator) {
494:       await validator(tx);
495:     }
496:     return tx.course.update({
497:       where: { id: courseId },
498:       data: { status: toStatus },
499:     });
500:   });
501: }

 50: export async function createLessonAtomic(
 51:   data: {
 52:     moduleId: string;
 53:     courseId: string;
 54:     title: string;
 55:     baseSlug: string;
 56:     durationMinutes?: number | null;
 57:     isFreePreview?: boolean;
 58:   },
 59:   maxAttempts = 5,
 60: ): Promise<Lesson> {
 61:   for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
 62:     const candidateSlug =
 63:       attempt === 1 ? data.baseSlug : `${data.baseSlug}-${attempt}`;
 64:     try {
 65:       return await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 66:         const course = await lockCourseForUpdate(tx, data.courseId);
 67:         if (course.status !== CourseStatus.DRAFT) {
 68:           throw new ValidationError(
 69:             "Cannot modify curriculum of a published or archived course",
 70:           );
 71:         }
 72:         const maxLesson = await tx.lesson.findFirst({
 73:           where: { moduleId: data.moduleId },
 74:           orderBy: { orderIndex: "desc" },
 75:           select: { orderIndex: true },
 76:         });
 77:         const newIndex = maxLesson !== null ? maxLesson.orderIndex + 1 : 0;
 78:         return await tx.lesson.create({
 79:           data: {
 80:             moduleId: data.moduleId,
 81:             title: data.title,
 82:             slug: candidateSlug,
 83:             orderIndex: newIndex,
 84:             durationMinutes: data.durationMinutes,
 85:             isFreePreview: data.isFreePreview ?? false,
 86:           },
 87:         });
 88:       });
 89:     } catch (error) {
 90:       if (
 91:         error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
 92:         error.code === "P2002"
 93:       ) {
 94:         if (attempt === maxAttempts) {
 95:           throw new ConflictError(
 96:             "Failed to assign a unique order index or slug for lesson after concurrent retries.",
 97:           );
 98:         }
 99:         continue;
100:       }
101:       throw error;
102:     }
103:   }
104:   throw new ConflictError(
105:     "Failed to create lesson due to concurrency collision",
106:   );
107: }

110:   courseId: string,
111:   data: {
112:     title?: string;
113:     durationMinutes?: number | null;
114:     isFreePreview?: boolean;
115:   },
116: ): Promise<Lesson> {
117:   return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
118:     const course = await lockCourseForUpdate(tx, courseId);
119:     if (course.status !== CourseStatus.DRAFT) {
120:       throw new ValidationError(
121:         "Cannot modify curriculum of a published or archived course",
122:       );
123:     }
124:     return tx.lesson.update({
125:       where: { id: lessonId },
126:       data,
127:     });
128:   });
129: }
130: export async function deleteLessonAtomic(
131:   lessonId: string,
132:   courseId: string,
133: ): Promise<Lesson> {
134:   return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
135:     const course = await lockCourseForUpdate(tx, courseId);
136:     if (course.status !== CourseStatus.DRAFT) {
137:       throw new ValidationError(
138:         "Cannot modify curriculum of a published or archived course",
139:       );
140:     }
141:     const lessonToDelete = await tx.lesson.findUnique({
142:       where: { id: lessonId },
143:       select: { id: true, moduleId: true, orderIndex: true },
144:     });
145:     if (!lessonToDelete) {
146:       throw new NotFoundError("Lesson not found");
147:     }
148:     const deleted = await tx.lesson.delete({
149:       where: { id: lessonId },
150:     });
151:     const siblings = await tx.lesson.findMany({
152:       where: {
153:         moduleId: lessonToDelete.moduleId,
154:         orderIndex: { gt: lessonToDelete.orderIndex },
155:       },
156:       orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
157:       select: { id: true, orderIndex: true },
158:     });
159:     for (const sibling of siblings) {
160:       await tx.lesson.update({
161:         where: { id: sibling.id },
162:         data: { orderIndex: sibling.orderIndex - 1 },
163:       });
164:     }
165:     return deleted;
166:   });
167: }
168: export async function reorderLessonsAtomic(
169:   moduleId: string,
170:   courseId: string,
171:   orderedIds: string[],
172: ): Promise<Lesson[]> {
173:   return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
174:     const course = await lockCourseForUpdate(tx, courseId);
175:     if (course.status !== CourseStatus.DRAFT) {
176:       throw new ValidationError(
177:         "Cannot modify curriculum of a published or archived course",
178:       );
179:     }
180:     const existingLessons = await tx.lesson.findMany({
181:       where: { moduleId },
182:       select: { id: true },
183:     });
184:     if (orderedIds.length !== existingLessons.length) {
185:       throw new ValidationError(
186:         "Invalid reorder permutation: IDs count must match existing lessons count",
187:       );
188:     }
189:     const uniqueOrderedIds = new Set(orderedIds);
190:     if (uniqueOrderedIds.size !== orderedIds.length) {
191:       throw new ValidationError(
192:         "Invalid reorder permutation: duplicate IDs are not allowed",
193:       );
194:     }
195:     const existingIdSet = new Set(existingLessons.map((l) => l.id));
196:     const allExist = orderedIds.every((id) => existingIdSet.has(id));
197:     if (!allExist) {
198:       throw new ValidationError(
199:         "Invalid reorder permutation: all IDs must match existing lesson IDs",
200:       );
201:     }
202:     for (let i = 0; i < orderedIds.length; i++) {
203:       await tx.lesson.update({
204:         where: { id: orderedIds[i] },
205:         data: { orderIndex: -1 - i },
206:       });
207:     }
208:     const updatedLessons: Lesson[] = [];
209:     for (let i = 0; i < orderedIds.length; i++) {
210:       const updated = await tx.lesson.update({
211:         where: { id: orderedIds[i] },
212:         data: { orderIndex: i },
213:       });
214:       updatedLessons.push(updated);
215:     }
216:     return updatedLessons;
217:   });
218: }

  1: import { CourseStatus } from "@prisma/client";
  2: import { ValidationError, NotFoundError } from "@/lib/errors";
  3: class AsyncLock {
  4:   private queue: Array<() => void> = [];
  5:   private locked = false;
  6:   async acquire(): Promise<() => void> {
  7:     if (!this.locked) {
  8:       this.locked = true;
  9:       return () => this.release();
 10:     }
 11:     return new Promise<() => void>((resolve) => {
 12:       this.queue.push(() => {
 13:         this.locked = true;
 14:         resolve(() => this.release());
 15:       });
 16:     });
 17:   }
 18:   private release() {
 19:     const next = this.queue.shift();
 20:     if (next) {
 21:       next();
 22:     } else {
 23:       this.locked = false;
 24:     }
 25:   }
 26: }

 28:   const courseLocks = new Map<string, AsyncLock>();
 29:   function getCourseLock(courseId: string): AsyncLock {
 30:     let lock = courseLocks.get(courseId);
 31:     if (!lock) {
 32:       lock = new AsyncLock();
 33:       courseLocks.set(courseId, lock);
 34:     }
 35:     return lock;
 36:   }

 59:     return course;

 62:     const release = await getCourseLock(courseId).acquire();

202:         );
203:       }

205:   );

307: export async function getCatalogCourses(
308:   options: CatalogQueryInput,
309:   userId?: string | null,
310: ): Promise<CatalogCoursesResponse> {
311:   const parsed = catalogQuerySchema.parse(options);
312:   const result = await courseRepository.findPublishedCoursesPaginated(parsed);
313:   const courseIds = result.courses.map((c) => c.id);
314:   const enrollmentMap = new Map<string, CourseEnrollment>();
315:   if (userId && courseIds.length > 0) {
316:     const enrollments =
317:       await enrollmentRepository.findEnrollmentsForUserAndCourses(
318:         userId,
319:         courseIds,
320:       );
321:     for (const e of enrollments) {
322:       if (
323:         e.status === EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE ||
324:         e.status === EnrollmentStatus.COMPLETED
325:       ) {
326:         enrollmentMap.set(e.courseId, e);
327:       }
328:     }
329:   }
330:   const items: CatalogCourseItem[] = result.courses.map((c) => {
331:     const enrollment = enrollmentMap.get(c.id);
332:     return {
333:       id: c.id,
334:       title: c.title,
335:       slug: c.slug,
336:       description: c.description,
337:       thumbnailUrl: c.thumbnailUrl,
338:       level: c.level,
339:       category: c.category,
340:       instructor: c.instructor,
341:       modulesCount: c._count.modules,
342:       totalLessons: c.totalLessons,
343:       enrollmentCount: c._count.enrollments,
344:       isEnrolled: Boolean(enrollment),
345:       progressPercentage: enrollment ? enrollment.progressPercentage : null,
346:     };
347:   });
348:   return {
349:     courses: items,
350:     totalCount: result.totalCount,
351:     page: result.page,
352:     limit: result.limit,
353:     totalPages: result.totalPages,
354:   };
355: }

359: export async function getCourseOverview(
360:   slug: string,
361:   userId?: string | null,
362: ): Promise<CourseOverviewDetail> {
363:   const course = await courseRepository.findCourseBySlug(slug, {
364:     includeCurriculum: true,
365:     includeInstructor: true,
366:   });
367:   if (!course) {
368:     throw new NotFoundError("Course not found");
369:   }
370:   if (course.status !== CourseStatus.PUBLISHED) {
371:     if (!userId) {
372:       throw new NotFoundError("Course not found");
373:     }
374:     const isOwner = course.instructorId === userId;
375:     const isAdmin = await hasRole(userId, "admin");
376:     if (!isOwner && !isAdmin) {
377:       throw new NotFoundError("Course not found");
378:     }
379:   }
380:   let enrollment: CourseEnrollment | null = null;
381:   let completedLessonIds: string[] = [];
382:   let isEnrolled = false;
383:   if (userId) {
384:     enrollment = await enrollmentRepository.findEnrollment(userId, course.id);
385:     if (
386:       enrollment &&
387:       (enrollment.status === EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE ||
388:         enrollment.status === EnrollmentStatus.COMPLETED)
389:     ) {
390:       if (
391:         course.status === CourseStatus.PUBLISHED ||
392:         course.instructorId === userId ||
393:         (await hasRole(userId, "admin"))
394:       ) {
395:         isEnrolled = true;
396:       }
397:     }
398:     if (
399:       isEnrolled ||
400:       course.instructorId === userId ||
401:       (await hasRole(userId, "admin"))
402:     ) {
403:       const progressRecords =
404:         await lessonProgressRepository.findProgressByUserAndCourse(
405:           userId,
406:           course.id,
407:         );
408:       completedLessonIds = progressRecords
409:         .filter((p) => p.isCompleted)
410:         .map((p) => p.lessonId);
411:     }
412:   }
413:   const completedSet = new Set(completedLessonIds);
414:   const rawModules = course.modules;
415:   const sortedModules = [...rawModules].sort(
416:     (a, b) => a.orderIndex - b.orderIndex,
417:   );
418:   let totalLessons = 0;
419:   const modules: CourseOverviewModule[] = sortedModules.map((mod) => {
420:     const sortedLessons = [...mod.lessons].sort(
421:       (a, b) => a.orderIndex - b.orderIndex,
422:     );
423:     totalLessons += sortedLessons.length;
424:     return {
425:       id: mod.id,
426:       title: mod.title,
427:       description: mod.description,
428:       orderIndex: mod.orderIndex,
429:       lessons: sortedLessons.map((l) => ({
430:         id: l.id,
431:         title: l.title,
432:         slug: l.slug,
433:         orderIndex: l.orderIndex,
434:         durationMinutes: l.durationMinutes,
435:         isFreePreview: l.isFreePreview,
436:         isCompleted: completedSet.has(l.id),
437:       })),
438:     };
439:   });
440:   return {
441:     course,
442:     modules,
443:     enrollment,
444:     isEnrolled,
445:     completedLessonIds,
446:     totalLessons,
447:   };
448: }

 31:   if (!hierarchy) {
 32:     throw new NotFoundError("Lesson not found");
 33:   }
 34:   const course = hierarchy.module.course;
 35:   const isPublicPreview =
 36:     hierarchy.isFreePreview && course.status === CourseStatus.PUBLISHED;
 37:   if (!isPublicPreview) {
 38:     if (!userId) {
 39:       throw new AuthenticationError(
 40:         "Authentication required to view this lesson content",
 41:       );
 42:     }
 43:     const isOwner = course.instructorId === userId;
 44:     const isAdmin = await authorizationService.hasRole(userId, "admin");
 45:     if (!isOwner && !isAdmin) {
 46:       if (course.status === CourseStatus.PUBLISHED) {
 47:         const isEnrolled = await enrollmentService.isUserEnrolled(
 48:           userId,
 49:           course.id,
 50:         );
 51:         if (!isEnrolled) {
 52:           throw new AuthorizationError(
 53:             "You must enroll in this course to access this lesson",
 54:           );
 55:         }
 56:       } else {
 57:         throw new AuthorizationError(
 58:           "You do not have permission to view this lesson content",
 59:         );
 60:       }
 61:     }
 62:   }
 63:   const content =
 64:     await lessonContentRepository.findLessonContentByLessonId(lessonId);
 65:   const rawResources = content?.resources;
 66:   const parsedResources: Array<{ name: string; url: string }> = Array.isArray(
 67:     rawResources,
 68:   )
 69:     ? (rawResources as Array<{ name: string; url: string }>)
 70:     : [];
 71:   return {
 72:     lessonId: hierarchy.id,
 73:     lessonTitle: hierarchy.title,
 74:     courseId: course.id,
 75:     bodyMarkdown: content?.bodyMarkdown ?? null,
 76:     bodyHtml: content?.bodyHtml ?? null,
 77:     videoUrl: content?.videoUrl ?? null,
 78:     resources: parsedResources,
 79:     isFreePreview: hierarchy.isFreePreview,
 80:   };
 81: }
 82: export async function updateLessonContent(
 83:   userId: string,
 84:   input: UpdateLessonContentInput,
 85: ): Promise<LessonContent> {
 86:   await authorizationService.requireAnyRole(userId, ["instructor", "admin"]);
 87:   const hierarchy = await lessonContentRepository.findLessonHierarchy(
 88:     input.lessonId,
 89:   );
 90:   if (!hierarchy) {
 91:     throw new NotFoundError("Lesson not found");
 92:   }
 93:   const course = hierarchy.module.course;
 94:   if (course.status === CourseStatus.ARCHIVED) {
 95:     throw new ValidationError(
 96:       "Cannot modify lesson content of an archived course",
 97:     );
 98:   }
 99:   const isOwner = course.instructorId === userId;
100:   const isAdmin = await authorizationService.hasRole(userId, "admin");
101:   if (!isOwner && !isAdmin) {
102:     throw new AuthorizationError(
103:       "You are not authorized to modify this lesson content",
104:     );
105:   }
106:   let normalizedVideoUrl: string | null | undefined;
107:   if (input.videoUrl !== undefined) {
108:     normalizedVideoUrl = input.videoUrl
109:       ? normalizeVideoUrl(input.videoUrl)
110:       : null;
111:   }
112:   let sanitizedHtml: string | null | undefined;
113:   if (input.bodyMarkdown !== undefined) {
114:     sanitizedHtml = input.bodyMarkdown
115:       ? await markdownToSanitizedHtml(input.bodyMarkdown)
116:       : null;
117:   }
118:   return lessonContentRepository.upsertLessonContent(input.lessonId, {
119:     bodyMarkdown: input.bodyMarkdown,
120:     bodyHtml: sanitizedHtml,
121:     videoUrl: normalizedVideoUrl,
122:     resources: input.resources,
123:   });
124: }
125: export interface LessonNavigation {
126:   previousLesson: { id: string; title: string } | null;
127:   nextLesson: { id: string; title: string } | null;
128:   totalLessons: number;
129:   currentIndex: number;
130: }
131: export async function getLessonNavigation(
132:   courseId: string,
133:   currentLessonId: string,
134: ): Promise<LessonNavigation> {
135:   const course = await courseRepository.findCourseById(courseId, {
136:     includeCurriculum: true,
137:   });
138:   if (!course) {
139:     throw new NotFoundError("Course not found");
140:   }
141:   type NavigationLesson = { id: string; title: string; orderIndex: number };
142:   type NavigationModule = { orderIndex: number; lessons?: NavigationLesson[] };
143:   const rawModules = (course as { modules?: NavigationModule[] }).modules ?? [];
144:   const sortedModules = [...rawModules].sort(
145:     (a, b) => a.orderIndex - b.orderIndex,
146:   );
147:   const flattenedLessons: Array<{ id: string; title: string }> = [];
148:   for (const mod of sortedModules) {
149:     const sortedLessons = [...(mod.lessons ?? [])].sort(
150:       (a, b) => a.orderIndex - b.orderIndex,
151:     );
152:     for (const lesson of sortedLessons) {
153:       flattenedLessons.push({ id: lesson.id, title: lesson.title });
154:     }
155:   }
156:   const currentIndex = flattenedLessons.findIndex(
157:     (l) => l.id === currentLessonId,
158:   );
159:   if (currentIndex === -1) {
160:     throw new NotFoundError("Lesson does not belong to this course");
161:   }
162:   return {
163:     previousLesson:
164:       currentIndex > 0 ? flattenedLessons[currentIndex - 1] : null,
165:     nextLesson:
166:       currentIndex < flattenedLessons.length - 1
167:         ? flattenedLessons[currentIndex + 1]
168:         : null,
169:     totalLessons: flattenedLessons.length,
170:     currentIndex: currentIndex + 1,
171:   };
172: }
173: export async function getCourseLessonForPlayer(params: {
174:   courseSlug: string;
175:   lessonId: string;
176:   userId?: string | null;
177: }): Promise<{
178:   course: Course;
179:   lesson: LessonContentDetail;
180:   navigation: LessonNavigation;
181: }> {
182:   const { courseSlug, lessonId, userId } = params;
183:   const course = await courseRepository.findCourseBySlug(courseSlug);
184:   if (!course) {
185:     throw new NotFoundError("Course not found");
186:   }
187:   const hierarchy = await lessonContentRepository.findLessonHierarchy(lessonId);
188:   if (!hierarchy) {
189:     throw new NotFoundError("Lesson not found");
190:   }
191:   if (hierarchy.module.course.id !== course.id) {
192:     throw new NotFoundError("Lesson not found in this course");
193:   }
194:   const isPublicPreview =
195:     hierarchy.isFreePreview && course.status === CourseStatus.PUBLISHED;
196:   if (!isPublicPreview) {
197:     if (!userId) {
198:       throw new AuthenticationError(
199:         "Authentication required to view this lesson content",
200:       );
201:     }
202:     const isOwner = course.instructorId === userId;
203:     const isAdmin = await authorizationService.hasRole(userId, "admin");
204:     if (!isOwner && !isAdmin) {
205:       if (course.status !== CourseStatus.PUBLISHED) {
206:         throw new NotFoundError("Course not found");
207:       }
208:       const isEnrolled = await enrollmentService.isUserEnrolled(
209:         userId,
210:         course.id,
211:       );
212:       if (!isEnrolled) {
213:         throw new AuthorizationError(
214:           "You must enroll in this course to access this lesson",
215:         );
216:       }
217:     }
218:   }
219:   const content =
220:     await lessonContentRepository.findLessonContentByLessonId(lessonId);
221:   const safeResources = parseSafeResources(content?.resources);
222:   const navigation = await getLessonNavigation(course.id, lessonId);
223:   return {
224:     course,
225:     lesson: {
226:       lessonId: hierarchy.id,
227:       lessonTitle: hierarchy.title,
228:       courseId: course.id,
229:       bodyMarkdown: content?.bodyMarkdown ?? null,
230:       bodyHtml: content?.bodyHtml ?? null,
231:       videoUrl: content?.videoUrl ?? null,
232:       resources: safeResources,
233:       isFreePreview: hierarchy.isFreePreview,
234:     },
235:     navigation,
236:   };
237: }
`````

 29: export async function toggleLessonCompletion(
 30:   userId: string,
 31:   lessonId: string,
 32:   completed: boolean,
 33: ): Promise<ToggleResult> {
 34:   const hierarchy = await lessonContentRepository.findLessonHierarchy(lessonId);
 35:   if (!hierarchy) {
 36:     throw new NotFoundError("Lesson not found");
 37:   }
 38:   const courseId = hierarchy.module.courseId;
 39:   const enrollment = await enrollmentRepository.findEnrollment(
 40:     userId,
 41:     courseId,
 42:   );

 44:     throw new AuthorizationError(
 45:       "You must enroll in this course to track progress",
 46:     );
 47:   }
 48:   return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 49:     const progress = await lessonProgressRepository.upsertLessonProgress(
 50:       userId,
 51:       lessonId,
 52:       completed,
 53:       tx,
 54:     );
 55:     const completedCount = await lessonProgressRepository.countCompletedLessons(
 56:       userId,
 57:       courseId,
 58:       tx,
 59:     );
 60:     const totalCount = await lessonProgressRepository.countTotalLessons(
 61:       courseId,
 62:       tx,
 63:     );
 64:     const percentage =
 65:       totalCount === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((completedCount / totalCount) * 100);
 66:     const isFullyComplete = percentage === 100;
 67:     const updatedEnrollment = await enrollmentRepository.updateEnrollment(
 68:       enrollment.id,
 69:       {
 70:         progressPercentage: percentage,
 71:         completedAt: isFullyComplete ? new Date() : null,
 72:         status: isFullyComplete
 73:           ? EnrollmentStatus.COMPLETED
 74:           : EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE,
 75:         lastAccessedAt: new Date(),
 76:       },
 77:       tx,
 78:     );
 79:     return { progress, enrollment: updatedEnrollment, percentage };
 80:   });

111: export async function getNextLesson(

113:   courseId: string,

117:   });
118:   if (!course) {

120:   }
121:   const courseWithModules = course as typeof course & {
122:     modules: Array<{
123:       id: string;
124:       title: string;
125:       orderIndex: number;
126:       lessons: Array<{
127:         id: string;
128:         title: string;
129:         orderIndex: number;
130:       }>;
131:     }>;
132:   };
133:   if (!courseWithModules.modules || courseWithModules.modules.length === 0) {
134:     return null;
135:   }
136:   const progressRecords =
137:     await lessonProgressRepository.findProgressByUserAndCourse(
138:       userId,
139:       courseId,
140:     );
141:   const completedSet = new Set(
142:     progressRecords.filter((p) => p.isCompleted).map((p) => p.lessonId),
143:   );
144:   for (const mod of courseWithModules.modules) {
145:     for (const lesson of mod.lessons) {
146:       if (!completedSet.has(lesson.id)) {
147:         return {

150:           moduleId: mod.id,
151:           moduleTitle: mod.title,

153:       }
154:     }
155:   }

`````markdown
 1: # Design Skills Cheat Sheet
 2: 
 3: Quick reference for daily work with design skills.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Three Dials
 8: 
 9: | Dial             | Default | Scale |
10: | ---------------- | ------- | ----- |
11: | Design Variance  | 8       | 1-10  |
12: | Motion Intensity | 6       | 1-10  |
13: | Visual Density   | 4       | 1-10  |
14: 
15: ---
16: 
17: # Anti-Slop Quick Check
18: 
19: - No Inter for everything.
20: - No purple-to-blue gradients.
21: - No cards in cards.
22: - No uniform spacing.
23: - No em-dashes in text.
24: - No boilerplate in production.
25: 
26: ---
27: 
28: # Typography Quick Rules
29: 
30: - Headlines: `text-wrap: balance`.
31: - Body: `text-wrap: pretty`, `max-w-[65ch]`.
32: - Numbers: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.
33: - Smoothing: `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`.
34: 
35: ---
36: 
37: # Interaction Quick Rules
38: 
39: - Hit areas: 40x40px minimum.
40: - Press: `scale(0.96)`.
41: - Shadows: three layers.
42: - Animation: ~100ms stagger, ~800ms enter.
43:

47: 
48: - One accent per page.
49: - One radius scale per page.
50: - One theme per page.
51: - Tokens from globals.css.
52:

56: 
57: - Headline: 2 lines max.
58: - Subtext: 20 words max.
59: - CTA: above fold.
60: - Padding: `pt-24` max.
61: - Elements: 4 max.

66:

69: 3. Define hero thesis.

## File: docs/deliverables/Unified Pre-Flight Mega Checklist.md
`````markdown
  1: # Unified Pre-Flight Mega Checklist
  2: 
  3: Combined checklist from all design skills. Run before every deliverable.
  4: 
  5: ---
  6: 
  7: # Architecture
  8: 
  9: - [ ] Follows layered architecture (UI -> Actions -> Services -> Repositories -> DB).
 10: - [ ] Business logic not in UI components.
 11: - [ ] Database access not in UI components.
 12: - [ ] Zod validation on all external input.
 13: - [ ] No `any` types.
 14: - [ ] Server Components by default.
 15: 
 16: ---
 17: 
 18: # TypeScript
 19: 
 20: - [ ] `pnpm run typecheck` passes.
 21: - [ ] No `any` types.
 22: - [ ] Inferred types preferred.
 23: - [ ] Reusable types exported.
 24: - [ ] Types close to the feature.
 25: 
 26: ---
 27: 
 28: # Biome
 29: 
 30: - [ ] `pnpm run lint` passes.
 31: - [ ] `pnpm run format:check` passes.
 32: - [ ] No disabled rules without justification.
 33: - [ ] No warnings.
 34: 
 35: ---
 36: 
 37: # Build
 38: 
 39: - [ ] `pnpm run build` succeeds.
 40: - [ ] No build errors.
 41: - [ ] No build warnings.
 42: 
 43: ---
 44: 
 45: # Tests
 46: 
 47: - [ ] `pnpm run test` passes.
 48: - [ ] Critical business logic tested.
 49: - [ ] Component tests for interactive UI.
 50: 
 51: ---
 52: 
 53: # Dead Code
 54: 
 55: - [ ] `pnpm run knip` passes.
 56: - [ ] No unused files.
 57: - [ ] No unused exports.
 58: - [ ] No unused dependencies.
 59: 
 60: ---
 61: 
 62: # Design: Color
 63: 
 64: - [ ] One accent color per page.
 65: - [ ] No purple-to-blue gradients.
 66: - [ ] No banned palettes.
 67: - [ ] Design tokens from globals.css.
 68: - [ ] No hardcoded colors.
 69: 
 70: ---
 71: 
 72: # Design: Typography
 73: 
 74: - [ ] `text-wrap: balance` on headlines.
 75: - [ ] `text-wrap: pretty` on body text.
 76: - [ ] Body: `max-w-[65ch]`.
 77: - [ ] Font smoothing enabled.
 78: - [ ] Tabular nums for numbers.
 79: - [ ] No em-dashes or en-dashes.
 80: 
 81: ---
 82: 
 83: # Design: Hero
 84: 
 85: - [ ] Headline: max 2 lines.
 86: - [ ] Subtext: max 20 words.
 87: - [ ] CTA above fold.
 88: - [ ] Top padding: max `pt-24`.
 89: - [ ] Max 4 text elements.
 90: 
 91: ---
 92: 
 93: # Design: Layout
 94: 
 95: - [ ] 4+ layout families in 8-section pages.
 96: - [ ] No cards in cards.
 97: - [ ] Grid broken intentionally.
 98: - [ ] Spacing deliberate.
 99: 
100: ---
101: 
102: # Design: Interactions
103: 
104: - [ ] 40x40px hit areas.
105: - [ ] `scale(0.96)` press feedback.
106: - [ ] Three-layer shadows.
107: - [ ] Shadows over borders.
108: - [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` honored.
109: - [ ] Icon animations with stagger.
110: 
111: ---
112: 
113: # Accessibility
114: 
115: - [ ] Focus rings visible.
116: - [ ] ARIA labels on icon buttons.
117: - [ ] Semantic HTML.
118: - [ ] WCAG AA contrast.
119: - [ ] Keyboard navigation works.
120: 
121: ---
122: 
123: # Performance
124: 
125: - [ ] Server Components used.
126: - [ ] Lazy loading for below-fold.
127: - [ ] Minimal client JS.
128: - [ ] Images optimized with next/image.
129: - [ ] Bundle size acceptable.
130: 
131: ---
132: 
133: # Documentation
134: 
135: - [ ] Relevant docs updated.
136: - [ ] Architecture decisions documented.
137: - [ ] Component inventory updated.
138: 
139: ---
140: 
141: # Anti-Slop
142: 
143: - [ ] No Inter for everything.
144: - [ ] No purple gradients.
145: - [ ] No cards in cards.
146: - [ ] No uniform spacing.
147: - [ ] No generic AI layouts.
148: - [ ] No boilerplate left in production.
`````

## File: docs/flows/Audit Pipeline Flow.md
`````markdown
 1: # Audit Pipeline Flow
 2: 
 3: Workflow for running quality audits on the project.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Pipeline Steps
 8: 
 9: ## 1. TypeScript Check
10: 
11: ```bash
12: pnpm run typecheck
13: ```
14: 
15: Verify: no errors, no warnings.
16: 
17: ## 2. Biome Check
18: 
19: ```bash
20: pnpm run lint
21: # or full project check (lint + format + typecheck + dead code):
22: pnpm run check
23: ```
24: 
25: Verify: no errors, no warnings.
26: 
27: ## 3. Build Check
28: 
29: ```bash
30: pnpm run build
31: ```
32: 
33: Verify: successful production build.
34: 
35: ## 4. Test Check
36: 
37: ```bash
38: pnpm run test
39: ```
40: 
41: Verify: all tests pass.
42: 
43: ## 5. Dead Code Check
44: 
45: ```bash
46: pnpm run knip
47: ```
48: 
49: Verify: no unused files, exports, or dependencies.
50: 
51: ## 6. Design Audit
52: 
53: - Run Section 14 pre-flight.
54: - Check against anti-slop patterns.
55: - Verify typography rules.
56: - Verify color rules.
57: 
58: ## 7. Accessibility Audit
59: 
60: - Check focus management.
61: - Check ARIA attributes.
62: - Check color contrast.
63: - Check keyboard navigation.
64: 
65: ## 8. Performance Audit
66: 
67: - Check bundle size.
68: - Check Server Component usage.
69: - Check lazy loading.
70: - Check image optimization.
71: 
72: ---
73: 
74: # Audit Results
75: 
76: Document findings in the relevant documentation:
77: 
78: - Architecture issues: `docs/rules/Architecture and Stack.md`.
79: - Design issues: `docs/rules/AI Tells (Forbidden Patterns).md`.
80: - Accessibility issues: `docs/rules/Vercel Interface Rule Categories.md`.
81: 
82: ---
83: 
84: # Documentation Rules
85: 
86: Every significant change should update the relevant documentation.
87: 
88: Architecture decisions should be documented before implementation whenever possible.
89: 
90: Documentation should always reflect the current state of the project.
`````

## File: docs/flows/Install and Load.md
`````markdown
 1: # Install and Load
 2: 
 3: How to install and load design skills in the project.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: # Skill Installation
 8: 
 9: ## Taste Skill
10: 
11: ```bash
12: npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill "design-taste-frontend"
13: ```
14: 
15: ## Impeccable
16: 
17: ```bash
18: npx impeccable install
19: ```
20: 
21: Then in your AI coding tool:
22: 
23: ```
24: /impeccable init
25: ```
26: 
27: ## Vercel Web Design Guidelines
28: 
29: ```bash
30: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines
31: ```
32: 
33: ## UI/UX Pro Max
34: 
35: ```bash
36: npm install -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli
37: uipro init --ai cursor
38: ```
39: 
40: ---
41: 
42: # Loading Skills
43: 
44: Skills are loaded in this order (tool-agnostic):
45: 
46: 1. **Project-level instructions** — read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.
47:    - If your tool does not auto-detect `AGENTS.md`, point it to the file explicitly or to a tool-specific mirror (e.g. `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`). These mirrors should be kept identical to `AGENTS.md`.
48:    - For MCP-based agents, use the filesystem MCP tool to read `AGENTS.md`.
49: 2. `docs/rules/` (architecture and design rules).
50: 3. `docs/skills/` (design skill references).
51: 4. `docs/flows/` (workflows).
52: 5. `docs/audits/` (quality checks).
53: 
54: ---
55: 
56: # Skill Conflict Resolution
57: 
58: When skills conflict:
59: 
60: 1. Project rules in `docs/rules/` take precedence.
61: 2. Vercel guidelines for accessibility and performance.
62: 3. Taste Skill for aesthetic direction.
63: 4. Impeccable for anti-pattern detection.
64: 5. MIFB for micro-interactions.
65: 
66: ---
67: 
68: # Verification
69: 
70: After installing skills:
71: 
72: 1. Run the audit pipeline.
73: 2. Verify no new conflicts.
74: 3. Update documentation if rules change.
`````

## File: docs/meta/CONVENTIONS.md
`````markdown
 1: # Conventions Reference
 2: 
 3: > **Note:** The comprehensive, canonical coding and architectural standards are defined in **[Coding Standards](../Coding%20Standards.md)** and **[Architecture](../Architecture.md)**. Please refer to those documents as the primary source of truth.
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: ## Quick Reference Summary
 8: 
 9: - **File Naming:** Components (`PascalCase.tsx`), Hooks (`useCamelCase.ts`), Utilities (`camelCase.ts`), Constants (`UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.ts`), Types (`types.ts`).
10: - **Imports:** Always use `@/...` path aliases. Never use deeply nested relative paths (`../../../../`).
11: - **Layers:** UI $\to$ Actions $\to$ Services $\to$ Repositories $\to$ Database. Business logic belongs strictly in Services.
12: - **Components:** Server Components by default; `"use client"` only for state, hooks, or browser event listeners.
13: - **Design Tokens:** Always use semantic tokens and `cn()`; no hardcoded hex/arbitrary values. See **[Design Tokens](../design/tokens.md)**.
14: 
15: ---
16: 
17: ## Documentation Change Tags
18: 
19: When updating repository documentation, use these standardized tags in commit messages and change logs:
20: 
21: - `feat` — New feature documentation.
22: - `fix` — Bug fix documentation or corrections.
23: - `docs` — Documentation-only modifications.
24: - `refactor` — Architecture, domain model, or convention changes.
25: - `perf` — Performance-related documentation.
26: - `test` — Testing documentation and verification suites.
`````

## File: docs/reference/Entities.md
`````markdown
  1: # Entities
  2: 
  3: Documentation of foundational tools and frameworks used in this project.
  4: 
  5: ---
  6: 
  7: # Next.js
  8: 
  9: - Version: 16.2.10
 10: - Role: React framework for server rendering, routing, and API.
 11: - Repository: vercel/next.js.
 12: - License: MIT.
 13: 
 14: ---
 15: 
 16: # React
 17: 
 18: - Version: 19.2.4
 19: - Role: UI library.
 20: - Repository: facebook/react.
 21: - License: MIT.
 22: 
 23: ---
 24: 
 25: # Tailwind CSS
 26: 
 27: - Version: v4
 28: - Role: Utility-first CSS framework.
 29: - Repository: tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.
 30: - License: MIT.
 31: 
 32: ---
 33: 
 34: # shadcn/ui
 35: 
 36: - Style: base-nova
 37: - Role: Reusable UI components.
 38: - Repository: shadcn-ui/ui.
 39: - License: MIT.
 40: 
 41: ---
 42: 
 43: # Prisma
 44: 
 45: - Version: 7.8.0
 46: - Role: TypeScript ORM for PostgreSQL.
 47: - Repository: prisma/prisma.
 48: - License: Apache-2.0.
 49: 
 50: ---
 51: 
 52: # Zod
 53: 
 54: - Version: 4.4.3
 55: - Role: Runtime validation.
 56: - Repository: colinhacks/zod.
 57: - License: MIT.
 58: 
 59: ---
 60: 
 61: # React Hook Form
 62: 
 63: - Version: 7.87.0
 64: - Role: Form management.
 65: - Repository: react-hook-form/react-hook-form.
 66: - License: MIT.
 67: 
 68: ---
 69: 
 70: # @hookform/resolvers
 71: 
 72: - Version: ^5.9.1
 73: - Role: Standard schema validation resolvers for React Hook Form (Zod adapter).
 74: - Repository: react-hook-form/resolvers.
 75: - License: MIT.
 76: 
 77: ---
 78: 
 79: # Better Auth
 80: 
 81: - Version: 1.7.3
 82: - Role: Authentication and session management framework.
 83: - Repository: better-auth/better-auth.
 84: - License: MIT.
 85: 
 86: ---
 87: 
 88: # Jest
 89: 
 90: - Version: 30.5.1
 91: - Role: Unit testing.
 92: - Repository: jestjs/jest.
 93: - License: MIT.
 94: 
 95: ---
 96: 
 97: # Biome
 98: 
 99: - Version: 2.5.12
100: - Role: Static analysis and code formatting.
101: - Repository: biomejs/biome.
102: - License: MIT.
103: 
104: ---
105: 
106: # Domain Entities
107: 
108: ## User
109: - Primary entity for system accounts and profiles.
110: - Table: `user`
111: - Core fields:
112:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String)
113:   - `name`: Display name (String)
114:   - `email`: Unique email address (String)
115:   - `emailVerified`: Email verification status (Boolean)
116:   - `image`: Auth provider avatar image URL (String, optional)
117: - Profile fields (Task 02):
118:   - `headline`: Professional headline, max 100 characters (String, optional)
119:   - `bio`: Biography summary, max 1000 characters (String, optional)
120:   - `avatarUrl`: Custom profile avatar URL (String, optional)
121:   - `website`: Portfolio/personal website URL (String, optional)
122: - Timestamps: `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
123: - Relations:
124:   - `userRoles`: `UserRole[]`
125:   - `sessions`: `Session[]`
126:   - `accounts`: `Account[]`
127:   - `authoredCourses`: `Course[]` (Authored courses)
128:   - `enrollments`: `CourseEnrollment[]`
129:   - `lessonProgress`: `LessonProgress[]`
130: 
131: ---
132: 
133: ## Role
134: - Role-based access control role identifier.
135: - Table: `role`
136: - Core fields:
137:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
138:   - `name`: Role name (`admin`, `instructor`, `student`) (String, unique)
139:   - `description`: Role description (String, optional)
140: - Timestamps: `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
141: - Relations:
142:   - `userRoles`: `UserRole[]`
143:   - `rolePermissions`: `RolePermission[]`
144: 
145: ---
146: 
147: ## Permission
148: - Granular action/resource entitlement.
149: - Table: `permission`
150: - Core fields:
151:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
152:   - `name`: Permission name (String, unique)
153:   - `description`: Permission description (String, optional)
154:   - `resource`: Target resource domain (String)
155:   - `action`: Permitted action (String)
156: - Constraints:
157:   - `@@unique([resource, action])`
158: - Timestamps: `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
159: - Relations:
160:   - `rolePermissions`: `RolePermission[]`
161: 
162: ---
163: 
164: ## UserRole
165: - Join table associating Users with Roles.
166: - Table: `user_role`
167: - Core fields:
168:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
169:   - `userId`: Reference to User (String)
170:   - `roleId`: Reference to Role (String)
171: - Constraints:
172:   - `@@unique([userId, roleId])`
173:   - `@@index([userId])`
174:   - `@@index([roleId])`
175: - Relations:
176:   - `user`: `User` (Cascade delete)
177:   - `role`: `Role` (Cascade delete)
178: 
179: ---
180: 
181: ## RolePermission
182: - Join table mapping Roles to Permissions.
183: - Table: `role_permission`
184: - Core fields:
185:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
186:   - `roleId`: Reference to Role (String)
187:   - `permissionId`: Reference to Permission (String)
188: - Constraints:
189:   - `@@unique([roleId, permissionId])`
190:   - `@@index([roleId])`
191:   - `@@index([permissionId])`
192: - Relations:
193:   - `role`: `Role` (Cascade delete)
194:   - `permission`: `Permission` (Cascade delete)
195: 
196: ---
197: 
198: ## Course
199: - Core curriculum container representing a complete educational course.
200: - Table: `course`
201: - Core fields:
202:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
203:   - `title`: Course title (String, 3..100 characters)
204:   - `slug`: URL-friendly identifier, unique globally (String, auto-generated from title with collision avoidance)
205:   - `description`: Detailed course summary (String, optional, max 1000 characters)
206:   - `thumbnailUrl`: Cover image URL (String, optional)
207:   - `status`: Lifecycle state (`DRAFT` | `PUBLISHED` | `ARCHIVED`, default: `DRAFT`)
208:   - `level`: Target audience proficiency level (`BEGINNER` | `INTERMEDIATE` | `ADVANCED` | `ALL_LEVELS`, default: `ALL_LEVELS`)
209:   - `category`: Subject taxonomy categorization (String, optional, max 50 characters)
210:   - `instructorId`: Reference to author User account (String)
211: - Timestamps: `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
212: - Relations:
213:   - `instructor`: `User` (Cascade delete)
214:   - `modules`: `Module[]` (Ordered by `orderIndex`)
215: - Indexes:
216:   - `@@index([instructorId])`
217:   - `@@index([status])`
218:   - Unique: `slug`
219: 
220: ---
221: 
222: ## Module
223: - Section/chapter grouping a sequence of lessons within a course.
224: - Table: `module`
225: - Core fields:
226:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
227:   - `title`: Section title (String, 2..100 characters)
228:   - `description`: Module description (String, optional, max 500 characters)
229:   - `orderIndex`: Zero-based contiguous sequential position within parent course (Int)
230:   - `courseId`: Parent course identifier (String)
231: - Timestamps: `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
232: - Relations:
233:   - `course`: `Course` (Cascade delete)
234:   - `lessons`: `Lesson[]` (Ordered by `orderIndex`)
235: - Constraints:
236:   - `@@unique([courseId, orderIndex])`: Guarantees deterministic, collision-free ordering per course
237:   - `@@index([courseId])`
238: 
239: ---
240: 
241: ## Lesson
242: - Atomic unit of instruction within a curriculum module.
243: - Table: `lesson`
244: - Core fields:
245:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
246:   - `title`: Lesson title (String, 2..100 characters)
247:   - `slug`: URL-friendly identifier within parent module (String, unique per module)
248:   - `orderIndex`: Zero-based contiguous sequential position within parent module (Int)
249:   - `durationMinutes`: Estimated duration (Int, optional, 1..600 minutes)
250:   - `isFreePreview`: Whether accessible without enrollment/payment (Boolean, default: `false`)
251:   - `moduleId`: Parent module identifier (String)
252: - Timestamps: `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
253: - Relations:
254:   - `module`: `Module` (Cascade delete)
255:   - `content`: `LessonContent?` (1-to-1, cascade delete)
256: - Constraints:
257:   - `@@unique([moduleId, slug])`: Enforces module-scoped slug uniqueness
258:   - `@@unique([moduleId, orderIndex])`: Guarantees deterministic, collision-free ordering per module
259:   - `@@index([moduleId])`
260: 
261: ---
262: 
263: ## LessonContent
264: - Heavy educational material payload linked 1-to-1 with a Lesson.
265: - Table: `lesson_content`
266: - Purpose: Isolates large markdown notes, code blocks, server-sanitized HTML, video embed links, and resource attachments from lightweight curriculum navigation queries.
267: - Core fields:
268:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
269:   - `lessonId`: Parent lesson identifier (String, unique)
270:   - `bodyMarkdown`: Author markdown text with code snippets (String, optional, max 50,000 characters)
271:   - `bodyHtml`: Server-compiled and sanitized HTML string (String, optional)
272:   - `videoUrl`: Normalized video embed URL from YouTube, Vimeo, or Loom (String, optional, max 500 characters)
273:   - `resources`: Array of resource attachments `{ name: string, url: string }` (Json, optional, max 10 attachments)
274: - Timestamps: `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
275: - Relations:
276:   - `lesson`: `Lesson` (Cascade delete, 1-to-1)
277: - Constraints:
278:   - `@@unique([lessonId])`
279: - Access Control:
280:   - Mutation: Authoring instructor or admin; allowed on `DRAFT` and `PUBLISHED` courses, strictly blocked on `ARCHIVED` courses.
281:   - Read: Public if `lesson.isFreePreview === true` AND `course.status === PUBLISHED`; otherwise restricted to authoring instructor, admin, or enrolled students (Task 05).
282: 
283: ---
284: 
285: ## Curriculum Enums
286: 
287: ### CourseStatus
288: - `DRAFT`: Course under development; editable by instructor. Default state.
289: - `PUBLISHED`: Publicly discoverable and enrollable. Requires >= 1 module and >= 1 lesson to transition. Curriculum mutations locked under draft state.
290: - `ARCHIVED`: Deprecated course; no new enrollments.
291: 
292: ### CourseLevel
293: - `BEGINNER`: Introductory material.
294: - `INTERMEDIATE`: Requires foundational knowledge.
295: - `ADVANCED`: Mastery-level technical topics.
296: - `ALL_LEVELS`: Suitable for any audience. Default level.
297: 
298: ### EnrollmentStatus
299: - `ACTIVE`: Student is actively enrolled and progressing through the course.
300: - `COMPLETED`: Student has completed all lessons (100% progress). `completedAt` timestamp is set.
301: - `ARCHIVED`: Enrollment is archived; student can no longer track progress.
302: 
303: ---
304: 
305: ## CourseEnrollment
306: - Tracks a student's enrollment in a course with aggregate progress metrics.
307: - Table: `course_enrollment`
308: - Core fields:
309:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
310:   - `userId`: Reference to enrolled student (String)
311:   - `courseId`: Reference to enrolled course (String)
312:   - `status`: Enrollment lifecycle state (`ACTIVE` | `COMPLETED` | `ARCHIVED`, default: `ACTIVE`)
313:   - `progressPercentage`: Aggregate course completion percentage (Int, 0 to 100, default: 0)
314:   - `enrolledAt`: Timestamp of initial enrollment (DateTime, auto-set)
315:   - `completedAt`: Timestamp when 100% completion is reached (DateTime, optional, cleared on revert)
316:   - `lastAccessedAt`: Timestamp of most recent progress activity (DateTime, auto-set)
317: - Timestamps: `enrolledAt`, `lastAccessedAt`
318: - Relations:
319:   - `user`: `User` (Cascade delete)
320:   - `course`: `Course` (Cascade delete)
321: - Constraints:
322:   - `@@unique([userId, courseId])`: One enrollment per student per course
323:   - `@@index([userId])`
324:   - `@@index([courseId])`
325: - Access Control:
326:   - Enroll: Any authenticated user, only in `PUBLISHED` courses.
327:   - Read (self): Student can view their own enrollments.
328:   - Read (course): Instructor or admin can view all enrollments for their course.
329:   - Mutate: System-level only (progress aggregation updates).
330: - Concurrency: Duplicate enrollment handled idempotently via `P2002` on unique constraint.
331: 
332: ---
333: 
334: ## LessonProgress
335: - Per-user, per-lesson completion tracking. Progress is strictly user-scoped and never shared.
336: - Table: `lesson_progress`
337: - Core fields:
338:   - `id`: Unique identifier (String, cuid)
339:   - `userId`: Reference to student (String)
340:   - `lessonId`: Reference to lesson (String)
341:   - `isCompleted`: Whether the lesson is marked complete (Boolean, default: `false`)
342:   - `completedAt`: Timestamp when lesson was marked complete (DateTime, optional, cleared on unmark)
343:   - `lastAccessedAt`: Timestamp of most recent interaction (DateTime, auto-set)
344: - Relations:
345:   - `user`: `User` (Cascade delete)
346:   - `lesson`: `Lesson` (Cascade delete)
347: - Constraints:
348:   - `@@unique([userId, lessonId])`: One progress record per student per lesson
349:   - `@@index([userId])`
350:   - `@@index([lessonId])`
351: - Access Control:
352:   - Read/Mutate: Student self only (`session.userId === progress.userId`).
353:   - Requires active enrollment in the parent course.
354: - Critical Invariant: Progress is NEVER stored as a global flag on the `Lesson` entity. It exists only in the `LessonProgress` join table scoped to `(userId, lessonId)`.
`````

## File: docs/rules/Architecture and Stack.md
`````markdown
 1: # Architecture and Stack
 2: 
 3: ## Layers
 4: 
 5: ```
 6: UI (Server Components) → Actions/Routes → Services → Repositories → Database (Prisma + Neon)
 7: ```
 8: 
 9: ## Responsibilities
10: 
11: | Layer              | Does                                                         | Must NOT                           |
12: | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
13: | **UI**             | Render, user interaction, state display                      | Business logic, direct DB access   |
14: | **Actions/Routes** | Request handling, auth, Zod validation, call services        | Business logic, direct repo access |
15: | **Services**       | Business rules, workflows, multi-repo coordination           | UI dependency, HTTP details        |
16: | **Repositories**   | DB queries, CRUD, persistence. Only layer that calls Prisma. | Business logic                     |
17: | **Database**       | Prisma models, migrations, PostgreSQL on Neon                | App logic                          |
18: 
19: ## Stack Integration
20: 
21: - **Next.js 16:** Server Components by default. Client only for state/browser APIs/events. Server Actions for mutations, Route Handlers for APIs, Metadata API for SEO.
22: - **Prisma + Neon:** serverless PG via `@prisma/adapter-neon`, WebSocket via `ws`, singleton client in `lib/db.ts`. Never instantiate Prisma in components.
23: - **Zod:** validate all external input. Type inference from schemas. Env validation via `@t3-oss/env-nextjs`.
24: - **Tailwind v4:** design tokens as CSS custom properties in `globals.css`, oklch color space, dark mode via `.dark` class, `cn()` via `clsx` + `tailwind-merge`.
25: 
26: ## Rules
27: 
28: - Business logic never in UI. DB access never in UI.
29: - Validate every external input with Zod.
30: - No `any`. Prefer inferred types.
31: - Server Components by default. Thin routes; delegate to services.
32: - Never modify production DBs manually. Use Prisma migrations.
33: - Never expose secrets, password hashes, or internal identifiers.
34: 
35: ## Data Flow
36: 
37: Request → Zod validation → Action/Route → Service → Repository → Prisma → PostgreSQL → back up the stack to Response.
`````

## File: docs/Components.md
`````markdown
 1: # Components
 2: 
 3: ## Folder Layout
 4: 
 5: ```
 6: components/
 7:   ui/        # shadcn/ui primitives (Button, Input, Card, Dialog, ...)
 8:   layout/    # Page structure (Header, Sidebar, Footer, Shell)
 9:   shared/    # Composed reusable components (SearchBar, UserMenu, EmptyState)
10: features/
11:   <feature>/ # Feature components co-located with feature
12: ```
13: 
14: ## Composition
15: 
16: ```
17: Page → Layout → Feature → Shared → UI
18: ```
19: 
20: ## Principles
21: 
22: - Single responsibility, reusable, props-driven, no hidden side effects.
23: - UI primitives: generic, no business logic.
24: - Feature components live next to their feature.
25: 
26: ## Accessibility (required on all interactive components)
27: 
28: Keyboard navigation · visible focus states · screen-reader labels · semantic HTML.
29: 
30: ## Styling
31: 
32: Tailwind utilities + design tokens from `globals.css`. No custom CSS unless necessary. No inline styles.
33: 
34: ## Creation Checklist
35: 
36: - [ ] Reuses an existing component if possible
37: - [ ] Generic and reusable
38: - [ ] Lives in the right folder (ui / shared / layout / feature)
39: - [ ] Accessible, responsive, properly typed
40: - [ ] Follows anti-slop design rules (see `docs/Design Rules.md`)
41: - [ ] Uses design tokens, not raw colors
42: - [ ] Intentional spacing, not uniform defaults
43: - [ ] Shadows over borders for depth
44: - [ ] Press states and ≥ 40×40 hit areas on interactive elements
`````

## File: docs/Design Rules.md
`````markdown
 1: # Design Rules
 2: 
 3: Frontend quality rules that prevent generic AI-generated output. Read before building any UI.
 4: 
 5: ## The Three Dials (set before layout)
 6: 
 7: | Dial             | Default | Purpose                                             |
 8: | ---------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
 9: | Design Variance  | 8       | How much layout breaks from generic grids           |
10: | Motion Intensity | 6       | Animation/transition presence                       |
11: | Visual Density   | 4       | Information per viewport (raise for data-heavy UIs) |
12: 
13: Defaults 8/6/4 work for most landing pages. Commit to a direction before touching layout.
14: 
15: ## Color
16: 
17: - One accent color, one radius scale, one theme per page.
18: - Never purple-to-blue gradients by default.
19: - Use design tokens from `globals.css`. No inventing new color variables.
20: 
21: ## Typography
22: 
23: - Body: `max-w-[65ch]`, `text-wrap: pretty`.
24: - Headlines: `text-wrap: balance`.
25: - Antialiasing on. Tabular nums for numeric data.
26: - No em-dash (U+2014) or en-dash (U+2013) in visible text. Use hyphens.
27: - More whitespace than feels necessary; add density deliberately.
28: - Prefer shadows/contrast over borders for separation.
29: 
30: ## Hero
31: 
32: - Headline ≤ 2 lines, subtext ≤ 20 words, CTA above the fold, top padding ≤ `pt-24`, max 4 text elements.
33: 
34: ## Navigation
35: 
36: - Single line at desktop. Height cap 80px (default 64-72). No hamburger on desktop.
37: 
38: ## Layout
39: 
40: - 8-section page → use ≥ 4 different layout families.
41: - Bento grids: exactly N cells for N items.
42: - Never cards-inside-cards.
43: - Break the grid at least once. Uniform spacing everywhere looks generated.
44: 
45: ## Micro-Interactions
46: 
47: - **Radius:** outer = inner + padding (concentric).
48: - **Press:** `scale(0.96)`. Never below 0.95.
49: - **Shadows:** compose from 3 layers (ambient, key, rim). Prefer over borders.
50: - **Hit areas:** minimum 40×40px (extend with pseudo-element if needed).
51: - **Animation:** icon `scale 0.25→1, opacity 0→1, blur 4px→0`; stagger ~100ms; enter ~800ms, exit subtler; spring `duration 0.3, bounce 0`.
52: - Always honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
53: - **Image outlines:** `1px` at `10%` opacity (black light / white dark).
54: 
55: ## Component Checklist
56: 
57: - [ ] No generic AI layout (cards-in-cards, uniform grids, centered everything)
58: - [ ] One accent color, no random gradients
59: - [ ] Typography uses `balance`/`pretty`
60: - [ ] Press states visible on interactive elements
61: - [ ] Shadows are multi-layered
62: - [ ] Hit areas ≥ 40×40px
63: - [ ] Animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`
64: - [ ] Spacing deliberate, not default
65: - [ ] Grid broken at least once
66: - [ ] No em-dashes or en-dashes in visible text
67: 
68: ## Anti-Patterns to Flag
69: 
70: Inter for everything without justification · purple-to-blue gradient backgrounds · cards-in-cards · uniform spacing · perfectly centered hero with no asymmetric element · no animation on any interactive element · borders instead of shadows · default Tailwind palette used raw · leftover "Welcome to Next.js" boilerplate.
71: 
72: ## Sources
73: 
74: Taste Skill · make-interfaces-feel-better · Impeccable · Anthropic frontend-design · ui-ux-pro-max · Vercel web-design-guidelines · Refactoring UI · Butterick's Practical Typography.
`````

## File: docs/Project Context.md
`````markdown
 1: # Project Context
 2: 
 3: ## Vision
 4: 
 5: Modern, scalable, production-ready web application. Clean architecture. Long-term quality over rapid feature development.
 6: 
 7: ## Goals
 8: 
 9: Solid foundation · business logic independent from UI · maximize reuse · great DX · AI-friendly codebase · low tech debt.
10: 
11: ## Priorities
12: 
13: 1. Maintainability
14: 2. Performance
15: 3. Scalability
16: 4. Developer Experience
17: 5. Accessibility
18: 6. Security
19: 
20: ## Constraints
21: 
22: TypeScript strict · Server Components by default · minimal client JS · SEO-friendly · accessible · reusable components · clean architecture.
23: 
24: ## Non-Goals
25: 
26: Over-engineering · premature optimization · unnecessary deps · large client bundles · duplicated business logic.
27: 
28: ## Success Criteria
29: 
30: Easy to extend, test, document, AI-understand, and onboard new developers.
31: 
32: ## Documentation Rules
33: 
34: Every significant change updates the docs. ADRs before implementation when possible. Docs always reflect current state.
`````
